title: Senior Engineer
description:
Halcy is an AI-powered group travel platform. We help people plan trips with the people they care about: generating itineraries, co-editing them in real time as a group, handling reservations, and guiding travellers through the journey. Halcy AB is based in Stockholm and the role is location-flexible.
 



  





 As Senior Engineer you will be the most senior technical person outside the founding team. You will own the architectural decisions that determine whether the platform works at its next order of magnitude, while continuing to write production code yourself.
 



  





 Success in the first year means three things: the platform holds under launch load without emergency intervention, an operational foundation exists and is trusted by the team, and the engineers who join after you are hired and onboarded through a process you designed. This role sets the technical standard for the engineering organisation as it grows from three people.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Own the architectural decisions that determine performance at scale, including concurrency, AI inference cost, collaborative state, and content delivery on mobile.
* Translate product direction into the technical bets that deliver it, and determine which problems to solve first.
* Establish and maintain the operational foundation: observability, error tracking, end-to-end coverage of critical user journeys, structured logging, alerting, and runbooks.
* Build the infrastructure that keeps delivery fast as the team grows, including continuous integration, preview environments, and automated database migrations.
* Write and ship production code every week alongside the founding team.
* Define the engineering hiring standard, including role descriptions, interview process, and onboarding for the next ten engineers.
* Identify decisions that are expensive to reverse and surface them while they are still open.
* Increase the capability of the engineers around you through code review, pairing, and technical mentorship.



  





**Required:** 



* At least five years building production systems, including a period as the most senior engineer in a small team.
* Deep TypeScript across the stack (React with Node or Deno), and the judgement to make architectural decisions without a senior peer to consult.
* A demonstrated track record of improving the engineers around you.
* Direct experience in at least one of the following: real-time multiplayer systems at scale; payments and bookings, for example Stripe combined with a travel or marketplace stack; or Postgres with extensive row-level security across hundreds of tables.



  





**Preferred:** 



* Mobile delivery experience with Capacitor, React Native, or native, including App Store and Google Play releases.
* A pragmatic approach to observability and security, with the ability to identify gaps before they cause incidents.
* Experience shipping AI-heavy products, including tool-use orchestration, multi-model gateways, prompt evaluation, and the cost mechanics of running LLMs in production. We run Anthropic and Gemini alongside each other.



  





**Compensation:** 



* €100,000 to €180,000, calibrated to experience
* Meaningful equity

title: Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.**
 Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.
   

  

 Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.
   

  

 The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.
   

  

 The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.
   

  

 As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Own features end-to-end across the stack: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React
* Design and evolve systems, not just features: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales
* Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform
* Make the product operable at enterprise scale: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence
* Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback
* Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature
* Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running


 We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.
   

  

**Technologies You'll Work With**
* Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
* TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
* Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
* k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
* Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key.
* For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.
* Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.
* Operational mindset. You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
* You are a systems thinker: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.
* Pragmatism and short feedback loops. You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
* You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
* You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience designing or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems at scale
* Experience with observability tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)
* Experience with Kubernetes in a production environment
* Familiarity with k6, Playwright, or browser automation at scale
* Experience contributing to or maintaining open source projects


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 610,000 - SEK 762,500. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Intelligence
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform. As the scale and diversity of content continues to grow—driven by advances in AI and new creation tools—we’re building intelligent systems that can evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.
   

  

 We’re seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding across Spotify. In this role, you’ll work on systems that generate deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images—enabling automation, improving quality, and unlocking new product experiences. This work is central to delivering safe, high-quality, and differentiated experiences for millions of listeners and creators worldwide.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Build and scale machine learning systems that generate deep understanding of content across modalities
* Develop models for classification, tagging, semantic understanding, and content enrichment
* Create high quality content enrichment at scale using LLMs and agentic systems.
* Design systems that make content intelligence signals available to downstream teams and products
* Improve automation for content quality, safety, and metadata enrichment at scale
* Collaborate with product, policy, and engineering teams to translate content intelligence into user impact
* Contribute to evaluation frameworks, data pipelines, and annotation systems
* Support rapid experimentation to prototype and launch new types of content signals
* Help improve system reliability, scalability, and performance across large datasets


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production
* You are comfortable working with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar
* You have experience working with large datasets and care about data quality and evaluation
* You are interested in or have worked with multimodal machine learning
* You understand how to design systems that balance automation with quality and user experience
* You are comfortable working on complex problems with evolving requirements
* You think in systems and understand how models connect to product outcomes
* You communicate clearly and work well across technical and non-technical teams


 Where You Will Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Backend Software Engineer (Go) - UniFi Connect
description:

Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons - all while shaping the future of connectivity.
   

  

**Join forces with us on our mission to build a better IT industry. We are currently looking for a highly skilled Backend Software Engineer (Go) to our team in Stockholm, Sweden.**
***Please note that applicants must live in Sweden and hold a valid work permit at the time of application to be considered for this role.***
**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement robust, scalable, and secure RESTful APIs
* Develop applications on embedded platforms, integrating closely with hardware and network systems
* Architect and document backend software systems with a focus on performance, maintainability, and scalability
* Perform network programming and system-level integration across multiple subsystems
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Frontend Engineering, UX Design, and QA to ensure cohesive product development
* Ensure high-quality deliverables and meet project timelines consistently
* Participate in code reviews and actively share knowledge to foster a culture of continuous improvement


**Requirements**
* 5+ years of experience with Golang in a production environment
* 5+ years of experience working with relational databases (RDBMS) such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and adaptable mindset
* Proficiency in AI development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and expertise in AI development techniques, such as Spec-Driven Development
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong sense of ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* Highly proficient in English (written and spoken)


**Nice To Have**
* Experience developing or maintaining IoT platforms or connected device ecosystems, including best practices for security (authentication, encryption, secure communication)
* Knowledge of IoT protocols such as MQTT, CoAP, or WebSockets for efficient communication
* Familiarity with Matter and Thread protocols, including their architecture, security, and implementation considerations
* Understanding of device provisioning, firmware over-the-air (OTA) updates, and device lifecycle management
* Exposure to edge computing paradigms and cloud-to-device integration patterns
* Proficiency in asynchronous programming and event-driven systems
* Experience with telemetry data collection, real-time data processing, and time-series data stores
* Familiar with Debian/Ubuntu, Linux application/service development, and CLI environment
* Familiar with Linux networking stack, routing, packet analysis (tcpdump/Wireshark), and firewall management


**Benefits**
* International work environment
* Competitive compensation package including wellness allowance, occupational pension, medical insurance, private health insurance, life insurance and work-injury insurance
* Five weeks of holiday per year
* Flexible work hours and hybrid work model
* Modern office space located in Epicenter (Hötorget)

title: AI Solutions Lead
description:
*We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique energy trading portfolios on the market.* 




  





*We’re looking for a* 
**AI Solutions Lead** 
*to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?* 




  





**Job Mission 🚀** 




 As AI Solutions Lead, you drive execution within Tibber's company-wide AI program. You embed in teams across the business, identify where AI can create the most value, and ship working solutions - fast.
 



  





 This is a hands-on strategic role. You combine technical depth with the ability to navigate stakeholders, align with business priorities, and scale what works across the organization.
 



  





**What You'll Do ✅** 



* Rapid AI Deployment
* Identify high-leverage opportunities for AI across Tibber’s products and operations
* Design and implement prototypes within days - not months
* Cross-Functional Impact
* Embed temporarily in different teams (product, customer support, trading, etc.)
* Translate business problems into AI-driven solutions
* Build & Ship
* Develop and deploy models, agents, and automations (LLMs, ML models, pipelines)
* Integrate AI into production systems with engineering teams
* Tooling & Enablement
* Create reusable AI tools, frameworks, and internal platforms
* Enable non-technical teams to leverage AI effectively
* Experimentation
* Run fast experiments, validate impact, and scale what works
* Balance speed with measurable business value



  





**What We're Looking For⚡** 




 You are a hands-on AI builder who enjoys turning business problems into working solutions. You are comfortable writing code, working closely with both engineers and business stakeholders, and taking ideas all the way into practice.
 



  





**Required Skills** 



* Strong hands-on experience building and deploying AI solutions in production
* Confident in Python or TypeScript, and comfortable working with APIs, data pipelines, and system integrations
* Have worked with LLM-based applications, such as automations, agents, or retrieval-based solutions
* Know how to move quickly from idea to prototype, and from prototype to real usage
* Have experience helping non-technical teams adopt AI in their workflows
* Are pragmatic, structured, and focused on business impact
* Communicate clearly and work well across functions



  





**We see it as a plus if you have...** 



* Experience with energy markets, IoT, or real-time data systems
* Background in startups or high-growth tech environments
* Familiarity with MLOps / deployment pipelines
* Experience with automation tools and internal AI platforms



  





**💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️The Tibber Mindset** 




 Tibber is not your typical energy supplier. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households lower and shift their energy consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours. We’re here to accelerate the energy transition – not in theory, but in everyday life.
 



  





 Being on a mission to change an industry, fundamentally also means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can’t be done, try and fail together but never lose sight of our users. We work passionately with sustainability and a circular approach, both with our own products and in the entire ecosystem that is affected by everything we do.
 



 Starting out with two passionate founders in 2016, we're now 300+ people working for Tibber in our offices in Stockholm, Førde, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Oslo. We will continue to grow within our markets, and we are thrilled to be backed by investors like Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa, and Schibsted.
 



  





*Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition?* 
***Apply below!***

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Policy & Safety
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Policy & Safety team sits within the Content Platform domain and builds the systems that keep Spotify safe and trustworthy at scale. We own the infrastructure behind content moderation, including detection models, policy enforcement systems, compliance pipelines, and the safety-by-default platform.
   

  

 Our work is critical to every new content type and product experience—from messaging and comments to collaborative and emerging AI-driven features. We partner closely with Trust & Safety, Legal, and Public Affairs to ensure that safety is built into Spotify experiences from the start.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Build and scale machine learning systems for proactive content detection, classification, and pre-publish safety scanning
* Design and implement policy evaluation frameworks, including standardized datasets, offline and online metrics, and continuous improvement loops
* Develop multimodal models that combine text, audio, image, and video signals for safety and policy enforcement
* Architect feedback loops that turn reviewer input into structured training data for continuous model improvement
* Translate regulatory requirements into scalable ML system designs, including accuracy and reporting expectations
* Partner with cross-functional teams across Trust & Safety, Legal, Public Affairs, and Product to deliver safe user experiences
* Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to long-term platform architecture
* Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping grow technical capability across the team


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience building and shipping production-grade machine learning systems at scale
* You are experienced with ML evaluation, including dataset design, metrics, and model performance monitoring
* You have worked with multimodal machine learning across text, audio, image, or video domains
* You have experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning, or feedback-driven model improvement
* You are comfortable translating complex requirements into technical solutions, including policy or regulatory constraints
* You are experienced working across teams and influencing technical direction in large systems
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners


 Where You Will Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Data Engineer / BI-utvecklare
description:
**OM ROLLEN** 




 Vill du kombinera teknik, problemlösning och nära samarbete med verksamheten? Som Data Engineer / BI-utvecklare på SEK är du med och omsätter affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som används i beslut kring finansiell risk och finansiering. Rollen passar dig som trivs i dialog med användare, gillar att förstå verksamheten på djupet och vill utveckla lösningar tillsammans med kollegor från både IT och affären.
 



  





 I rollen kommer du att:
 


* Arbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till datadrivna lösningar
* Ta in och tolka krav samt bidra med förbättringsförslag och nya perspektiv
* Implementera nya funktioner och vidareutveckla vårt datalager, analysverktyg och beräkningslösningar
* Förvalta och förbättra tekniska lösningar, processer och arbetssätt



  





 Vi arbetar i en Microsoft-miljö med T-SQL för ETL och datalagring, Power BI och SSRS för rapportering samt OLAP- och tabulära kuber för analys. Python används för beräkningar och avancerad analys. Vi har ett starkt fokus på automation, kvalitet och spårbarhet och använder verktyg som Git, Jira och Azure DevOps. Majoriteten av dataprocessningen sker schemalagt och varje team ansvarar för sina flöden.
 



 Samtidigt lägger vi grunden för en ny teknisk plattform – där du får möjlighet att bidra och påverka riktningen framåt.
 



  





**OM DIG** 




 Vi tror att du har flerårig erfarenhet av datalagerutveckling, ETL och komplex SQL. Vi ser gärna att du har tidigare erfarenhet från bank eller finans och använder Python i ditt arbete.
 



 Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränssnittet mellan affär och teknik. Du arbetar nära Business Analysts, arkitekter och andra utvecklare för att omsätta behov till robusta datalösningar och driva förbättringar framåt. Du uppskattar dialog, är nyfiken på olika perspektiv och tror att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans. Om du föredrar att arbeta helt självständigt under långa perioder kommer du sannolikt inte att trivas lika bra i rollen.
 



  





 Vidare är du bekväm med både svenska och engelska som arbetsspråk. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Azure DevOps, databasoptimering eller arbete i miljöer med höga krav på kvalitet, spårbarhet och regulatorisk efterlevnad.
 



  





**OM TEAMET OCH VÅR ARBETSPLATS** 




 Hos oss möter du en kultur präglad av samarbete, kompetens och en enkel princip: alla frågor är bra frågor. Du blir en del av ett team med cirka 17 kollegor som arbetar med data, analys och beslutsstöd inom flera delar av verksamheten. Teamet är uppdelat i mindre grupper med totalt fyra Tech Leads, kopplade till olika verksamhetsområden. Vi värdesätter ett öppet kunskapsutbyte och tror att de bästa lösningarna växer fram genom samarbete, dialog och olika perspektiv. I rollen arbetar man även nära andra utvecklingsteam såväl som arkitekter, säkerhets- och operationsteam samt verksamheten.
 



  





 Hos oss får du också:
 


* En tydlig, samhällsviktig mission – att stärka svenska företags internationella konkurrenskraft och bidra till grön omställning
* Möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, arkitektur och tekniska vägval
* En roll där ditt engagemang märks och gör skillnad i verksamheten



  





 Vårt kontor ligger på Fleminggatan 20 i Stockholm. Vi ses vanligtvis minst tre dagar i veckan på kontoret och har i övrigt ett flexibelt arbetssätt med möjlighet till distansarbete.
 



  





**ANSÖKAN** 




 Välkommen med din ansökan! Bifoga ditt CV och svara på våra urvalsfrågor – något personligt brev behövs inte. Sista ansökningsdag är 29 augusti 2026. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta Agnes Munter, Rekryteringsansvarig, agnes.munter@sek.se.

title: Verksamhetsutvecklare
description:
Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna ansvarar för drift av hjälpmedelsverksamhet för personer med rörelsehinder i södra delen av Stockholms län samt länsövergripande ansvar för personer med behov av förbrukningshjälpmedel i hemmet, medicinteknisk apparatur i hemmet samt kommunikations-, kognitions-, syn- och hörselhjälpmedel.
   

  





 Vi söker en verksamhetsutvecklare till Verksamhetsstöd på Hjälpmedelsverksamheterna. På enheten är vi 20 medarbetare som stöttar verksamheten med bla. ekonomi, verksamhetsuppföljning, IT och patientsäkerhet.
   

  





 Du kommer ha din arbetsplats på något av våra tre kontor (två i Solna, ett i fruängen), men kommer regelbundet vara på alla kontor. Vi värdesätter samarbetet när vi ses, och det finns möjlighet till distansarbete när det passar uppgifterna.
   

  





  
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter**




 I rollen som verksamhetsutvecklare driver du projekt, skapar förutsättningar för utveckling och arbetar med konkreta initiativ för att förbättra verksamheten. Det gör du i samarbete med kollegorna på enheten och kärnverksamheten. Du stöttar ledningens styrprocesser genom att bereda beslutsunderlag samt bidra till verksamhetsplanering och uppföljning. Du fungerar även som ett internt bollplank och erbjuder stöd till chefer inom ex. förändringsledning och förbättringsarbete.
   

  





**Arbetsuppgifter är bland annat** 



* Samordna och prioritera våra utvecklingsinsatser för en röd tråd i hela verksamheten.
* Driva utvecklingsprojekt som förbättrar och effektiviserar våra processer och rutiner.
* Leda tvärfunktionella projektgrupper och forum från olika enheter för att säkra delaktighet och framdrift.
* Säkra att nya arbetssätt, projektresultat samt externa direktiv från Regionen implementeras väl.
* Identifiera utvecklingsbehov genom att strukturera, visualisera och genomlysa interna flöden.
* Agerar strategisk länk mellan verksamheten och verksamhetsstöd genom att t.ex. översätta verksamhetens behov till tydliga krav för IT.



**Din bakgrund**




 Vi söker en trygg och driven verksamhetsutvecklare med erfarenhet från en liknande roll, där du framgångsrikt skapat struktur och konkreta resultat. Du är van vid att röra dig mellan olika specialistfunktioner och har god förståelse för hur utveckling bedrivs i praktiken med grund i verksamhetens behov.
   

  





**Du har** 



* Relevant högskoleutbildning, ex inom systemvetenskap, ekonomi, offentlig förvaltning, teknik eller motsvarande
* Många års erfarenhet från en liknande roll
* Erfarenhet av att självständigt planera, driva och slutföra projekt
* Erfarenhet av att samordna utvecklingsaktiviteter över en hel verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av att agera brygga mellan olika funktioner, t.ex. mellan verksamhet och IT
* Praktisk erfarenhet av förändringsledning och implementering av nya arbetssätt
* Erfarenhet av att arbete i enlighet med ledningssystem samt av processutveckling och kartläggning av processer
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att planera och leda workshops för att driva utveckling
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift



**Vi söker dig som**




 Du är relationsskapande och har en mycket god samarbetsförmåga som gör att du bygger förtroende på alla nivåer och hanterar intressekonflikter konstruktivt. Som person är du initiativtagande och drivande; du sätter självständigt igång aktiviteter, tar ansvar för framdrift och ser till att beslut faktiskt blir genomförda. Du planerar, organiserar och prioriterar ditt arbete effektivt inom tydliga tidsramar och använder din analytiska förmåga för att bryta ned komplexa frågeställningar och omsätta data till konkreta beslutsunderlag. Dessutom besitter du en god ledarförmåga som gör att du kan motivera tvärfunktionella projektgrupper och skapa engagemang utan ett formellt chefskap. Avslutningsvis är du tydlig och kommunikativ där du med lätthet anpassar ditt budskap efter mottagaren.
   

  





 Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering, enligt gällande regelverk.
   

  





**Vid patientnära arbete inom Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde:**




  

 - tillämpas registerkontroll före beslut om anställning enligt SLSO:s övergripande anvisning för registerkontroll vid anställning.
   

  





  

 - ska medarbetare som kommer att ha patientkontakt genomgå nyanställningsundersökning, enligt gällande direktiv, vilket sker genom företagshälsovården innan anställning.
   

  





  

 - krävs, förutom svensk yrkeslegitimation, goda kunskaper i svenska språket motsvarande nivå C1 enligt den gemensamma europeiska referensramen (GERS). Samma krav är vägledande vad gäller icke-legitimerad personal med patientkontakt.
   

  





**Stockholms läns sjukvårdsområde (SLSO) är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare med 11 600 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder hälso- och sjukvård i Region Stockholms regi inom psykiatri, primärvård, geriatrik, ASIH, närakuter, somatisk specialistvård, habilitering och hälsa samt hjälpmedel. I samverkan med Karolinska Institutet bedriver vi forskning, utbildning och utveckling. Läs mer om SLSO här.**




****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: Senior .NET Utvecklare
description:
*Vill du arbeta med moderna .NET-lösningar i en komplex och samhällsviktig miljö? Just nu genomför vi en större modernisering av våra system samtidigt som vi utvecklar ny funktionalitet och bygger helt nya tjänster. Vi bygger moderna mikrotjänster i .NET, arbetar eventdrivet med RabbitMQ och har CI/CD via Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy. Framåt vill vi komplettera våra förmågor med OpenShift Container Platform samt streaming via Kafka – vill du vara med och leda den resan?*
 OBS - återkoppling kan komma att dröja tills slutet av augusti då vi är inne i semestertider.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Som .NET-utvecklare får du en nyckelroll i ett engagerat och drivet team som arbetar med både förvaltning och nyutveckling av huvudsakligen egenutvecklade applikationer och tjänster, men även som beställaransvariga för externa leveranser. Teamet har ett viktigt uppdrag kopplat till regelefterlevnad och informationsförsörjning och är en central del i arbetet med att motverka penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism.
   

  

 Vår systemmiljö består idag av många system och integrationer som tillsammans skapar en tekniskt komplex helhet. En viktig del av rollen handlar därför om att hjälpa till att minska komplexiteten över tid genom smartare lösningar, modern arkitektur och successiv konsolidering av äldre system. Samtidigt handlar rollen inte bara om modernisering och teknisk skuld – en stor del av arbetet kretsar också kring nyutveckling, nya tjänster och nya tekniska initiativ där det finns stort utrymme att påverka både lösningar och arbetssätt framåt.
   

  

 Det finns stora möjligheter till inflytande över tekniska frågor i rollen, och vi tror att du gillar att ta ansvar, driva initiativ och arbeta långsiktigt med produkter och plattformar som utvecklas över tid. För att trivas och vara framgångsrik i rollen tror vi också att du uppskattar att diskutera tekniska lösningar tillsammans med andra utvecklare och ser värdet i att bygga robusta lösningar som fungerar bra både idag och på längre sikt.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:
   

  

* Utveckla och förvalta applikationer och tjänster inom .NET
* Bidra med förbättringsförslag och driva införandet av ny teknik
* Samarbeta i ett agilt team med utvecklare, testare, arkitekt, product owner och IT-specialist
* Vara med och utveckla skalbara och säkra lösningar inom finans och bank


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning inom relevant område eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling inom .NET
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av moderna .NET-ramverk, C#, Clean Architecture och SOLID-principer


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Vana att bygga skalbar, testbar och asynkron backendkod samt att designa och konsumera REST-API:er
* Erfarenhet av eventdriven arkitektur, gärna med RabbitMQ
* Erfarenhet av Blazor, React och TypeScript och trivs med fullstackarbete
* Goda kunskaper i SQL och datamodellering
* Erfarenhet av Docker, containerisering och att sätta upp en effektiv containerstruktur
* Vana vid Azure DevOps, pipelines, CI/CD och molnbaserade lösningar i Azure samt On-Prem
* Erfarenhet av AML/KYC-processer, gärna inom bank eller finans
* Erfarenhet av lean-agila arbetssätt (SAFe eller liknande)
* Erfarenhet från bank- eller finanssektorn


 Som person är du kommunikativ och relationsskapande, med förmåga att både leda dig själv och samarbeta väl med andra. Du har ett stort eget driv, tar ansvar, är flexibel och bidrar med en positiv inställning till teamets utveckling. Du håller dig gärna uppdaterad kring nya tekniker, kommer med förbättringsförslag och trivs i en miljö som är både förändringsbenägen och komplex.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: karolina.klemenz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: jonny.knutas@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Länsförsäkringar Bank är en av Sveriges största och mest omtyckta banker, med ett brett utbud av tjänster inom betalningar, sparande, bolån och fonder. I arbetet mot vår vision "Tillsammans skapar vi trygghet och möjligheter" hoppas vi att du vill bidra med ditt engagemang och nyfikenhet för effektivisering, AI samt omvärldsspaning av moderna verktyg och metoder för att driva vår utveckling framåt.

Experience working in digital sales, e-commerce, travel or other conversion-intensive environments.
  
Degree within Interaction Design, Engineering or similar
  
Minimum 6 years’ experience working with UX/UI with complex user journeys.
  
Proficiency in English and Swedish.
  
  

The position is a permanent full-time position, based at our headquarters in Norrtull, Stockholm. Does this sound like an opportunity for you? Send in your application today – we truly look forward to hearing from you! Please note that selection takes place on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait too long.
  
  

Do you have questions about the role? Don’t hesitate to contact Hanna Johansson at hanna.johansson@apollo.se. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to our HR department: HR@apollo.se
  
  

About the company
  
  

Apollo is one of the leading travel organizers in the Nordic region, with approximately 700 000 travelers each year. We have about 300 employees distributed across our Nordic offices, and during our summer and winter seasons, the workforce grows with an additional 100–250 seasonal employees. We offer customers the opportunity to explore the world, whether they dream of a relaxing sun-and-beach holiday, an energizing training week in warmer climates, or an exciting city adventure over a weekend. We arrange package tours, training trips, cruises, and city breaks to cater to all travel needs. Additionally, we offer flexible flight and hotel bookings for those who prefer to customize their trips.
  
  

Since 2015, Apollo has been part of DERTOUR Nordic AB, along with Golf Plaisir and Lime Travel. We are also part of the German REWE Group, which has over 400 000 employees.
  
  

Our mission is to fulfill our customers' holiday dreams by offering exceptional service and experiences. To achieve our vision of being Northern Europe’s most engaging and leading holiday provider, we are always looking for driven and innovative employees, whether as tour guides at one of our destinations or working within the production and sales of our tours.
  
  

Apollo also aims to promote sustainable travel and social responsibility through collaborations with organizations such as SOS Children's Villages, ECPAT, and the Swedish Olympic Committee (SOK). Since 2016, we have been proud of our TravelLife certification. For more information, visit www.apollo.se.

title: Regional Sales Director - Located in Middle East
description:
Since 2014, Wiremind has positioned itself as a technical company transforming the world of transport and events with a 360° approach combining UX, software, and AI.


Our expertise lies primarily in optimizing and marketing our clients' capacity. We work on various projects such as ticket forecasting and pricing, 3D optimization of air freight or scraping competitor prices. Our applications are the preferred tool of companies such as SNCF, United Airlines, Qatar Airways or even PSG to visualize, analyze and optimize their capacity.


Dynamic and ambitious, we strive to maintain our technical DNA which is the engine of our success. The company, profitable and self-financed since its creation 10 years ago, is mainly composed of engineers and experts and currently supports the growth of our business model based on "software-as-a-service" solutions.

### **The role**

As part of its international expansion, Wiremind is strengthening its commercial leadership. This is a strategic “market-opening” position, designed for a highly autonomous leader capable of building a regional presence from the ground up. Its distinctive, “first boots on the ground” nature means the successful candidate will be the very first Wiremind representative in the region, responsible for establishing the company’s presence, shaping the go-to-market approach, and laying the foundations for future growth. The role demands a rare blend of commercial excellence, an entrepreneurial mindset, and operational autonomy.


The Regional Sales Director Middle East is responsible for driving new business growth, expanding Wiremind’s footprint, and building long-term strategic relationships with enterprise customers across the Middle East region. The role combines strategic account leadership, complex solution selling, and regional market development.

##### **1. Regional Business Development & Growth**

* Own and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve ambitious revenue targets.
* Identify, qualify, and close new enterprise opportunities across the transportation sector.
* Build and maintain a robust pipeline aligned with Wiremind’s strategic priorities.
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from prospecting to contract signature.

##### **2. “First Boots on the Ground” Market Launch**

* Act as Wiremind’s first local representative, establishing the company’s presence in the region.
* Localize Wiremind’s commercial approach, messaging, and value proposition to regional market dynamics.
* Build and structure a regional ecosystem of customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
* Support the setup of local operations, including legal, administrative, and compliance-related matters.
* Contribute to future team growth by identifying talent needs and participating in early recruitment efforts.
* Operate independently from a home office or coworking space while maintaining strong alignment with global teams.

##### **3. Strategic Account Leadership**

* Develop long-term, trust-based relationships with C-level and senior decision-makers.
* Understand customer challenges and position Wiremind’s solutions to deliver measurable business value.
* Partner with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure seamless onboarding and long-term account growth.

##### **4. Market Intelligence & Regional Positioning**

* Act as Wiremind’s regional ambassador at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.
* Monitor competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging trends in the region.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Leadership teams to influence roadmap and market strategy.

##### **5. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing to tailor regional campaigns and lead-generation initiatives.
* Collaborate with Pre-Sales, Product, and Data Science teams to design compelling solution proposals.
* Contribute to global sales forecasting, reporting, and strategic planning.

### **Your profile**

* 10+ years of enterprise / complex B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of opening new markets or territories.
* Deep familiarity with the Asia Pacific region and its business culture; established C-level network in transportation, logistics, or adjacent enterprise sectors is a strong advantage.
* Entrepreneurial, self-starting leader comfortable operating solo and building structure where none exists.
* Experience selling data-driven, SaaS, or optimization solutions into large, multi-stakeholder organizations.
* Fluent English; Arabic language skills are a strong plus. Willingness to travel extensively across the region.
* Based in Middle East but working fully remote
* Alignment with Wiremind’s values: ownership, rigor, and a hands-on, builder mindset.

### **Recruitment Process**

* A screening interview with Talent Acquisition
* A screening interview with our CRO
* A use case to be prepared and presented to the team
* A meeting with our CEO


Wiremind is committed to **equality of opportunity, diversity, and fairness**. We encourage all **candidates** with the necessary experience to apply for our job offers.
