title: POWER söker E-commerce Manager till huvudkontoret i Barkarby
description:
**POWER Sverige söker E-commerce Manager**


POWER är en av Nordens ledande omnikanalkedjor inom hemelektronik. Vi befinner oss nu i en av de mest spännande faserna i bolagets historia — med en kraftig expansion i Sverige och en snabbväxande digital verksamhet som spelar en central roll i den resan. Vår vision är att vara världens mest kundvänliga varuhus, och e-handelsfunktionen är avgörande för att vi ska nå dit.


Nu söker vi en E-commerce Manager som vill äga och driva den svenska e-handelsaffären på riktigt. Det är inte en koordineringsroll. Det är ett affärsansvar.


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med inledande provanställning på sex månader, tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

**Om rollen**


Du tar operativt och strategiskt ägarskap över POWER.se med fullt mandat att driva trafik, konvertering och omsättning. Du sitter nära marknadsledningen och arbetar tätt med kampanjteamet, category management och tech — och dina beslut syns direkt i resultaträkningen.

**Vad du ansvarar för**

* Äga och utveckla POWER.se kommersiellt — trafik, konvertering, intäkt och marginal
* Planera och genomföra kampanjer i nära samarbete med marketing och kategori
* Sätta datadriven agenda för löpande optimering av sajten — A/B-tester, UX-förbättringar, personalisering
* Samarbeta internt och med externa tech-partners kring plattformsutveckling & roadmap
* Bygga och följa upp KPI-struktur som speglar affärsutfall, inte bara trafikvolymer
* Ha koll på konkurrentbilden och snabbt kunna agera på marknadsförändringar

**Vad vi letar efter**

* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att driva e-handel i en kommersiell miljö med mätbara resultat
* Stark analytisk förmåga och van att navigera i GA4, BI-verktyg och CRM-data
* Naturlig nyfikenhet kring AI-verktyg och hur de kan användas för att arbeta smartare
* Förmåga att sätta prioriteringar och fatta beslut i en organisation som rör sig snabbt
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och påverka utan formell linjemyndighet
* Förståelse för det bredare omnikanallandskapet — du förstår att e-handel och fysisk handel hänger ihop
* Ledarambition — du vill inte bara sköta en funktion, du vill bygga något

**Varför POWER**


Vi har en stark vinnarkultur i bolaget där vi når våra mål med Mod, Glädje och Entusiasm. Hos oss är värdeorden Öppen, Ärlig, Proffsig och På — inte fraser på en vägg, utan något som syns i hur vi arbetar och tar beslut varje dag.


Du får en roll med reell påverkan i ett bolag som är tillräckligt stort för att satsningarna syns, men tillräckligt snabbrörligt för att du faktiskt kan forma verksamheten. Här finns 100 % mandat — och 100 % ansvar för resultatet.

**Ansökan**


POWER välkomnar alla sökande och värdesätter jämställdhet, inkludering och mångfald i teamet.


Skicka in din ansökan snarast, urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Skicka in din ansökan med ett kort brev om vad du vill åstadkomma i rollen – inte bara vad du har gjort. I våra rekryteringsprocesser genomför vi en bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat innan anställning kan bli aktuell.

**Välkommen till möjligheternas arbetsplats hos oss på POWER!**

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Want to Shape How Millions Pay on FINN, Blocket & other Nordic Marketplaces?
  
  

THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELLYou? A strategic product leader with a deep understanding of modern payment ecosystems. You thrive on navigating complex partnerships and driving cross-functional alignment to build seamless, secure financial experiences.Role? Product Manager on our Payment team, owning the vision, strategy, and execution of our payment solutions across our brands, bridging between external payment partners, technical delivery teams, and internal business stakeholders to scale our transactional capabilities.Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics go to find what they need, whether it's second-hand goods, a job, a home or a way to move. Location? Join us in our Oslo or Stockholm office where you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely 3 days a week. Why us? This is your chance to lead a fast-scaling transactional platform that directly impacts millions of Nordic users. You drive high-visibility partnerships, cultivate an evolving team culture, and experience dedicated personal and professional growth in a highly collaborative environment.Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
  
  

WHO ARE YOU?
  
  

Proven experience building and leading digital products from concept to execution, with a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and transactional models.
  
You possess the influence and negotiation skills required to manage external payment providers and fintech partners, ensuring mutually beneficial, high-performing collaborations, as well as internal vertical stakeholders.
  
You’re adaptable and can pivot smoothly when priorities shift based on business results and help your team navigate changes with steadiness.
  
**You combine vision with pragmatism:** You have the ability to translate a 5-year vision into clear, actionable short-term wins that keep the momentum going.
  
**High professional-level fluency in English:** You effortlessly manage internal stakeholders, translating complex technical constraints to business leaders and aligning business objectives with engineering realities.
  
  

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?As our Product Manager for the Payments Team, you own the core transactional experiences that define our marketplaces. Your main objective is to lead the team in building the best transactional and payment solutions as a foundational core layer. You manage the balance between ambitious forward-thinking strategies and continuous, value-driven software delivery
  
  

**Your Day-to-Day & Key Projects:**  

Lead the continuous development of our new digital wallet and accelerate the cross-border scaling of our escrow solutions beyond Norway into our other Nordic markets.
  
Evaluate and direct negotiations with major external payment vendors and financial partners to optimize our capabilities.
  
Guide a dedicated squad of developers and UX designers, contributing to a structured, psychologically safe, and high-performing team culture.
  
Interface closely with leadership across our commercial verticals to ensure the payments roadmap directly facilitates broader business goals.
  
  

**What success looks like in 6 months to one year:**  

You have built deep trust with the product team, smoothed out cross-location collaboration dynamics, established a consistent short-term delivery cadence, and assumed ownership of key external partner relationships.
  
You have seamlessly scaled the payment/escrow solutions across multiple Nordic markets and established a sustainable, predictable product delivery structure that bridges long-term vision with operational realities.
  
  

**A few words from Product Director, Lene Graff Christensen:**  

"Hi, I am Lene Graff Christiansen, Product Director of Marketplace Platforms. The Payments team builds the transactional heartbeat of our marketplace—and we are looking for a strong product mind to help us scale it.We are a collaborative and curious team that values deep ownership and turning bold visions into measurable results. I am looking for someone who will confidently own this domain, bring fresh industry insights to the table, and challenge our current way of thinking. If you are ready to tackle complex payment challenges, this is a fantastic opportunity to broaden your expertise, grow as a product leader, and make a massive impact on Vend’s future."
  
  

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you! Make sure to apply by August 19th. You don't need to write an application letter, we are more interested in your answers to the questions in the application form. QUESTIONS?Product Director Lene Graff Christiansen is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Lene is best reached by e-mail: lene.graff[at]vend.com
  
  

**At Vend, our mission is simple:** Smart choices made easy.
  
  

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.
  
  

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.
  
  

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

title: UX/UI Designer – PostNord App, Solna
description:
Vill du göra vardagen enklare för våra nordiska användare?
   

  

 Vill du designa produkter som används av miljontals människor varje månad – och göra vardagen lite enklare för kunder i hela Norden?
   

  

 Vi söker nu en UX/UI Designer till vårt Consumer Apps‑team, med fokus på PostNord Appen som idag används brett i Sverige, Danmark och Finland - och snart även i Norge. Här får du arbeta med en produkt där varje detalj du designar gör skillnad.
   

  

 Som UX/UI Designer hos oss arbetar du hands-on genom hela designprocessen - från att förstå problem och användarbehov till att ta fram lösningar som implementeras i produkten.
   

  

 Rollen har en tydlig tyngd på UI och visuellt hantverk. Samtidigt handlar arbetet mycket om att navigera komplexitet – förstå affärsregler, samordna med stakeholders och driva initiativ framåt i organisationen.
   

  

**Du Kommer**
* Ta del av ägandeskap för design av konkreta flows, funktioner och gränssnitt
* Skapa wireframes, interaktionsdesign, prototyper och färdig UI
* Säkerställa hög kvalitet, tillgänglighet och konsistens i leveranser
* Arbeta nära utvecklare för att säkerställa att design är genomförbar
* Kollaborera med produktägare och stakeholders för att driva lösningar framåt
* Du blir en viktig del i att realisera och vidareutveckla designarbetet tillsammans med UX Lead.


 ,
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du**
* Har erfarenhet av att designa digitala produkter för native appar (UX/UI)
* Är trygg i att arbeta självständigt, men också öppen för feedback och vägledning
* Har ett starkt öga för UI, detaljer och visuellt hantverk
* Har djup kunskap i Figma (inkl. komponenter, variabler eller liknande arbetssätt)
* Förstår hur man designar robusta flöden med olika states och edge cases
* Har god förståelse för både UX och UI – och hur de samverkar i praktiken
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta nära utvecklare och navigera tekniska begränsningar
* Har kunskap om WCAG och tillgänglighet
* Är självgående och driver arbete framåt i en komplex miljö
* Är stark i stakeholder management och kommunikation


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid inställning och arbetssätt. Vi tror att du gillar att lösa problem, samarbeta och ta dig an komplexa utmaningar – snarare än att enbart fokusera på “nya features” eller stora redesigns.
   

  

**Extra Viktigt i Rollen**
* Förståelse för plattformsspecifika designprinciper (iOS / Android) och deras begränsningar
* Förmåga att motivera designbeslut utifrån dessa principer
* Erfarenhet av designsystem – du behöver inte äga ett, men ska kunna arbeta och bidra i ett
* Förmåga att skapa och arbeta med komponenter och strukturer i större skalor


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av större organisationer eller komplexa produktmiljöer
* Erfarenhet av mobilappar med hög användarvolym
* Intresse för hur AI kan användas för att effektivisera design- eller arbetsflöden
* Erfarenhet av verktyg/arbetsflöden som Jira, design tokens eller liknande


**Vad Du Kan Förvänta Dig**
* Arbeta med en produkt med miljontals användare i Norden
* Vara en del av ett team där design spelar en viktig roll i produktutvecklingen
* Samarbeta tätt med utveckling och produkt i vardagen
* Möjlighet att påverka både detaljer och helhetsupplevelse


**Vi gör vardagen enklare**
 PostNord är den ledande leverantören av kommunikations- och logistiklösningar till, från och inom Norden. Vi säkerställer postservicen till privatpersoner och företag i Sverige och Danmark. Vi strävar efter att göra vardagen enklare och mer hållbar för alla som bor och arbetar i Norden. Vi är ansvarstagande, modiga och engagerade, och leder effektivt förändring oavsett om vi leder oss själva eller andra. Vi uppmuntrar lagarbete, uppriktighet och positiva relationer på arbetsplatsen. Vi bygger vidare på våra framgångar och lär oss av både kollegor och misstag. Människor med olika bakgrund arbetar hos oss. Du kommer därför vara en del av en arbetsplats med stor mångfald, vilket bidrar till bättre resultat för verksamheten. Besök oss på www.postnord.com.
   

  

**Ansök**
 Vad väntar du på? Välkommen med din ansökan! Urval sker löpande, men på grund av semestertider kan återkoppling komma att dröja något – vi planerar att tidigast återkomma som
 **tidigast i mitten på augusti.**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Digital Content & Web Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
*This is a fixed term, 9-month assignment.*
**Shape And Improve The Electrolux Home Web Experience**
 At Electrolux, we have been improving everyday life for more than 100 years. Today, digital experiences play an important role in how we engage consumers, support our partners and drive growth across our channels.
   

  

 We are now looking for a hands-on Digital Content & Web Specialist to join the Electrolux Home marketing team on a 9-month assignment. In this role, you will help improve the Electrolux Home website by working with content, customer journeys, navigation, web performance and data-driven optimization.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong web management experience with a commercial mindset and enjoys turning insights into concrete improvements that strengthen the customer experience and support business performance.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As Digital Content & Web Specialist, you will support the day-to-day development and optimisation of the Electrolux Home website, with a focus on content quality, user experience, conversion and operational excellence.
   

  

**You will:**
* Manage and optimize website content, landing pages and navigation to improve the customer journey.
* Use web analytics, customer behavior data and performance insights to identify improvement opportunities.
* Identify and help resolve friction points, UX issues and conversion barriers across the website.
* Support campaign launches by ensuring that web content, landing pages and customer journeys are ready and effective.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, tech teams, agencies and external partners to prioritize and implement improvements.
* Track key website KPIs such as traffic, engagement, conversion and commercial performance.
* Contribute to improving web processes, governance and ways of working to ensure a high-quality digital experience.


**What You Bring**
 You are a hands-on web and content specialist with a strong commercial mindset. You understand how content, UX, navigation and data work together to improve the customer journey and drive digital performance. You are structured, proactive and comfortable working with several stakeholders to get things done.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of experience in web management, digital content, e-commerce or website optimization.
* Strong hands-on experience working with CMS platforms and managing website content.
* Good understanding of digital customer journeys, UX principles and conversion optimization.
* Experience using web analytics tools, such as GA4, to identify issues and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to translate insights into concrete actions that improve engagement, conversion and commercial performance.
* Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, tech teams and/or external partners.
* Fluent in Swedish is a must.


**Nice to have**
* Experience from D2C or e-commerce environments.
* Knowledge of SEO best practices.
* Experience with CRO, A/B testing or landing page optimization.
* Experience supporting digital campaigns or coordinating agencies and external partners.


**Why join us?**
 This is an opportunity to make a visible impact on one of Electrolux Home’s key consumer-facing digital platforms. You will be part of a collaborative and international environment where your expertise and actions will help improve the digital experience for consumers and support commercial growth.
   

  

 Screening of applications will start in August, after the summer vacation break.

title: Head of IT Operations & End User Experience
description:
Munters is looking for a Head of IT Operations & End User Experience to lead the global operational performance of our workplace and site IT services and shape the technology experience for employees across offices, engineering centers and manufacturing sites. The team consists of around 40 employees across APAC, Europe and the Americas, currently working in a regional structure.
   

  

 In this role, you will build a globally aligned service organization that combines consistent global capabilities with strong local presence and business understanding. A key part of the mandate is to modernize traditional support and operations through AI, automation, intelligent self-service, modern IT service management and Microsoft workplace technologies. The ambition is to leverage existing structures and modern technology to enable a global L1 service capability while maintaining strong local support where it matters most.
   

  

 The role balances two equally important responsibilities: ensuring stable, secure and efficient day-to-day service delivery, while continuously improving how IT end user services are delivered, consumed and experienced across Munters. You will work closely with the full IT leadership team, especially Security & Infrastructure and Application Engineering, to create one integrated technology organization with clear accountability, strong governance and a seamless end-to-end service experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead global IT operations and service delivery across EMEA, Americas and APAC, ensuring stable, secure and reliable support for employees and business-critical sites.
* Own workplace technologies, service desk, device deployment and lifecycle services, local site IT operations, escalation models and major incident management.
* Establish a globally aligned service delivery model with clear ownership, accountability and governance across L1/L2/L3, in close collaboration with Infrastructure & Security and Application Engineering.
* Design and mature a scalable Level 1 capability combining self-service, AI-assisted support, remote delivery and effective local escalation.
* Drive standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement across services, processes and tools, using data, analytics and employee feedback.
* Own the strategy, roadmap, service design and operational performance of Microsoft 365 and common workplace services, including governance, lifecycle management and cost-effective licensing.
* Partner with business functions, HR and Communications to increase adoption of collaboration, communication, productivity and AI capabilities.
* Lead and develop a global team with a strong service mindset, business understanding and clear accountability for outcomes.
* Manage strategic vendors, service providers and key workplace technology partners to deliver consistent quality, performance and value.
* Own budgets, service costs, commercial performance and productivity improvements within the area.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Proven experience leading global IT Operations, Workplace Services, Site IT, Service Delivery or End User Experience organizations.
* Ability to lead global teams, vendors and transformation across regions while balancing operational discipline, security, standardization and local business needs.
* Experience from complex operational environments spanning offices, engineering centers and manufacturing or other business-critical sites.
* Strong understanding of modern IT service management, operational excellence, service ownership, governance and continuous improvement.
* Experience establishing or maturing global service desk and Level 1 capabilities, including multi-provider service models.
* Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, self-service and data-driven approaches to transform support and service delivery.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Copilot, modern workplace platforms, endpoint services and licensing models.
* Strong commercial, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to connect technology decisions to business value and employee experience.

title: Principal Designer - Parking
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**The Role**
 We’re looking for a seasoned and highly capable Product Designer that has experience in elevating design impact across a wide range of products, in a complex space. In this role, you will work closely with key stakeholders and product designers to maximize the quality of the user experience in several realms.
   

  

 We’re in a phase of continuous and intense iteration, refinement and reshaping of several parts of our product offering. Our ambitions are high – we want to have a world-class portfolio of products that effectively meet our users needs and have a strong and positive impact on their day to day lives. The person in this role will play an integral part in achieving this.
   

  

 You will be working out of a centralized design team, together with design leadership, UX Research, Writing and Localization, supporting initiatives across several product verticals and ecosystems (including apps, web, wearables, automotive, as well as hardware). In your day to day, you will spend a lot of time with the full, 30 person strong, design team. You will be reporting to the Head of Product Design.
   

  

 The broader R&D organization includes a genuinely diverse and distributed team of over 450 talented specialists in product, engineering, design, and analytics.
   

  

**How To Make An Impact**
* Having a strong focus on collaboration and enablement, with an entrepreneurial mindset. Roll up your sleeves and partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders and peers, to elevate execution and impact across the product offering.
* Drive or support ambitious, ambiguous and strategically important projects from a design standpoint. Cover work spanning across teams and domains to ensure consistency, quality and impact.
* Support in shaping the longer term direction for the suite of products. Work to define both visual directionality and strategic momentum. Uncover and support in capitalizing on new, undiscovered opportunities.
* Ensure a high bar of quality and consistency across products. Support and mentor junior and senior designers, developing craft, enabling best practices, and strengthening design culture. Take a systemic approach and ensure processes are clear and efficient.


**About You**
 You are a well experienced product designer with a strong track record of shipping impactful work. You’ve likely spent plenty of time at product companies – either larger ones, or startups – working in cross-functional contexts, but agency side experience is also of relevance.
   

  

 You have a world-class foundation in craft, allowing you to execute quickly with an outstanding bar of quality. You also hold an ability to quickly grasp strategic perspectives. Your experience and skillset means that you can navigate ambiguity with ease and are comfortable tackling nuanced challenges with senior stakeholders, as well as more junior collaborators.
   

  

 You’re equally comfortable with taking on initiatives to improve processes, or coach more junior designers, as you are with creating high fidelity prototypes, weaving complex functionality into elegant interfaces with ease.
   

  

**Your background**
* 10+ years of experience in design, with an emphasis on product design work in cross functional contexts.
* Demonstrated experience from working with ambiguous challenges, collaborating with senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience in leading high stakes product design work, including early stage discovery phases, with examples of contributions on successful products.
* World-class craftsmanship – creating high quality design work is second nature, and something you do very quickly. Rapid, high fidelity, prototyping is a given for you.
* 2+ years of experience in people management, mentoring or coaching.


 This role is a hybrid working role and can be based in our offices located across Stockholm, Amsterdam, London, Łódź, Barcelona or Atlanta - 3 days in the office per week, 2 from home.
   

  

 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Senior Producer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Producer to join an exciting new project early in its development phases. You will get a chance to help build a multi-disciplinary team from the ground up, participate in hiring, establish how the team achieves success and then lead them towards those successes.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Overseeing the development process, managing timelines, resources, scope, and quality
* You are responsible for end-to-end delivery, ensuring predictable project outcomes through effective tracking, risk mitigation, and problem-solving
* You understand pipelines, identify bottlenecks, and work systematically to improve efficiencies
* Assume accountability for overall team progress and timely delivery of milestones and other key deliverables.
* Ensure that needed ceremonies (such as stand-up, retros, progress reporting etc) are instituted and conducted.
* Be a champion for your team by removing blockers, optimizing the flow of communication, facilitating collaboration and nurturing a sense of shared ownership.
* Establish and continuously evolve workflows and pipelines.
* Participate in hiring for your team and facilitate relaxed but efficient onboarding experiences.
* Identify ways to leverage outsourcing opportunities where sensible
* Assume people management responsibilities for a group of developers, supporting them in their growth and career development. You are accountable for the entire employee journey of your direct reports, from hiring to onboarding, probation period evaluation, all the way to eventual offboarding


**Who You Are**
* At least 5 years experience as a Producer or Project Manager.
* Been involved with at least one game project through a complete development cycle.
* Has led a full or significant part of a multi-disciplinary development team.
* Thorough understanding of agile game development methodologies.
* Experience of common tools of trade such as JIRA, Confluence, Figma etc.
* Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Servant-leadership, team-first and collaborative mindset.


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:

 At Precis, we are a group of friendly experts in media buying, analytics & marketing science, creative and technology with a joint mission to help great companies thrive in the digital landscape.
   

  

 Are you curious to learn more about us? Read more about us here. For insights into what life is like at Precis and a peek at the perks of working with us, visit this page. In our Handbook, you can get a neat summary of who we are, our culture and our offices.
 **In**

**, we have summarised what our recruitment process looks like. Take a look!**

We believe that a diverse set of minds will continue to contribute to our innovative culture and our ability to reinvent ourselves constantly.*

**About The Role**
 A Senior SEO Specialist is a SEO expert, developing and implementing impactful SEO tactics and clear outcomes in client collaborations. With deep technical and operational knowledge, this role drives innovation, initiating continuous testing and optimisation, and conducting thorough analysis to derive actionable insights. In collaboration with clients and team members, the Senior SEO Specialist addresses complex challenges with SEO-specific expertise, transforming them into solutions that contribute to the overarching strategic direction. Integral to the role is the ability to share knowledge and maintain a standard of SEO excellence within the team.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing 💼**

* Direct advanced testing and optimisation initiatives within SEO, applying deep expertise to enhance effectiveness and meet client KPIs.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
We are super excited to announce that Robin Bodin is now looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Insights & Activation product area, focused on building the trusted data foundation that powers analytics, predictive models, and future AI capabilities across Voyado Engage.
   

  

 Our mission is to make analytics data reliable, governed, and actionable end to end — from canonical data products and semantic standards to the metrics and insights surfaced to customers. As part of this journey, we’re evolving both our data foundations and analytics products to create a more scalable, transparent, and trustworthy platform.
   

  

 We work in short feedback loops, close collaboration with stakeholders, and a strong belief that progress comes from learning and iteration — not just shipping.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is not a traditional BI or dashboarding role.
   

  

 Team Intelligence is responsible for the analytics and reporting capabilities inside Voyado Engage. We’re evolving towards a modern analytics foundation where governed datasets, certified metrics and semantic definitions are treated as shared product assets that power both embedded analytics and future AI-driven experiences.
   

  

 As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll build and own the data products behind our customer-facing analytics. Working hands-on with SQL, Databricks and modern data tooling, you’ll model, validate and improve datasets, metric definitions and data quality processes. A key part of the role is identifying inconsistencies, duplicated logic and unclear ownership, and turning that into scalable and trusted solutions.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of analytics, product and engineering. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX, analytics engineers and domain teams to ensure our analytics are understandable, consistent and reliable for customers
   

  

 Some of the things you'll be up to:
   

  

* Designing and building governed data products with clear schemas, quality tests, lineage and ownership
* Writing SQL to model, transform and validate structured data
* Building and maintaining semantic definitions and certified metrics across analytics surfaces
* Collaborating with domain teams to improve data quality and upstream ownership
* Contributing to documentation, contracts and standards that make analytics reliable and understandable
* Supporting the foundation behind embedded BI and future AI-powered analytics capabilities


 So, who are you?
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical ownership with a thoughtful and collaborative mindset. You care deeply about data quality, consistency and building systems that others can trust and scale on top of.
   

  

 You probably enjoy turning ambiguous business questions into clear and reliable metric definitions, and you prefer solving problems at the source rather than patching them downstream. You care about details like semantic clarity, documentation and naming conventions because you understand their long-term impact on both people and systems.
   

  

 At the same time, you enjoy collaborating across engineering, product, UX and customer-facing teams to build analytics experiences that are both technically robust and genuinely useful.
   

  

 Besides the above, we believe you've got:
   

  

* Strong SQL skills for data exploration, transformation and validation
* Experience with dbt or similar tooling for governed data transformations
* Experience building or maintaining data products, semantic layers or certified metrics
* Understanding of concepts such as lineage, data contracts, canonical entities and quality testing
* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery


 Experience within retail tech, e-commerce, Databricks or lakehouse-style data platforms is considered a strong plus.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:
   

  

* An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
* Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
* An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.


 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.
   

  

 With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.
   

  

 Ready to find out more?
   

  

 Lovely! 🎉
   

  

*Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!*
**Making it personal with AI**
 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.
   

  

 Vacation period!
   

  

*As we are heading out for the vacation period, feedback on your application might take a little longer than usual. Don't hesitate to send in your application, though; we'll do our best in getting back to you as soon as possible! 🌴*
 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: Senior Marketing Data Strategist
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**
 We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1.1 billion smokers in the world and around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives, and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering better nicotine alternatives online.
   

  

 Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands across seven markets, serving more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com and Nicokick.com we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish-style snus and other smoke-free products online.
   

  

 With our headquarters on Östgötagatan in Stockholm, we are around 300 colleagues, mainly based in Sweden but working across markets globally. We are an innovative and fast-moving company on an exciting expansion journey, helping more and more smokers switch to smoke-free alternatives.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Marketing Data Strategist** 
 to join Haypp Group’s Acquisition team within the Marketing function and take ownership of how we measure, understand, and optimize marketing performance across all markets. In this role, you will shape and drive our marketing measurement and data strategy, building the foundation that enables better investment decisions, stronger customer insights, and long-term growth. You will move the organization from channel-level optimization towards a holistic view of customer acquisition, lifetime value, and business impact.
   

  

 This is a highly strategic and cross-functional role where you will work closely with Marketing, Finance, Product, Tech, CRM, and Data & Insights. You will challenge assumptions, influence decision-making, and build scalable frameworks that support how we evaluate marketing effectiveness across markets and channels. You will also lead our journey towards a more advanced measurement ecosystem, where Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), attribution, and customer value analysis work together to guide smarter decisions and future capabilities such as personalization and AI-driven insights.
   

  

 Hybrid work model with in-office collaboration Tuesday to Thursday at our Stockholm office on Södermalm, balancing flexibility with strong team connection
   

  

**In this role, you will:**
* Own and evolve Haypp Group’s marketing measurement and analytics strategy, building the data foundation needed to understand marketing performance, customer value, and investment efficiency
* Own and evolve a scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, and data structures that give clear visibility into performance across markets, channels, and customer segments
* Lead the development of measurement frameworks across paid media, CRM, SEO, and other channels – including attribution, customer value analysis, segmentation, and lifecycle analytics
* Drive the Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) agenda end-to-end, from defining business needs and evaluating vendors to implementation and long-term ownership
* Partner closely with Marketing, Finance, Product, Tech, and Data teams to ensure consistent definitions, reliable data, and aligned decision-making frameworks
* Translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations that directly impact growth, efficiency, and profitability
* Support the shift towards more personalized, lifecycle-driven marketing through better use of first-party data, while helping shape future capabilities within AI, automation, and advanced analytics


**What We Are Looking For**
* You have solid experience within marketing analytics, data strategy or customer insights (ideally in e-commerce), and are comfortable working hands-on with measurement, attribution, and performance reporting
* You understand how different measurement approaches fit together – including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) – and can evaluate marketing investments across channels with a clear view of trade-offs and impact
* You bring a strong commercial mindset and naturally connect marketing activities to customer value, revenue, and long-term profitability
* You’re confident working with data and tools such as Big Query, MMM systems, Google platforms, BI platforms, CRM systems, or similar, and enjoy translating complex datasets into clear, actionable insights
* You’re used to working cross-functionally, collaborating with stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Product, and Tech, and know how to align teams around data-driven decisions
* You have a structured way of thinking, enjoy solving complex problems, and build scalable frameworks rather than one-off analyses
* You communicate clearly and effectively, and can make complex concepts understandable and relevant for non-technical stakeholders
* You’re fluent in English


**YOU WILL PROBABLY THRIVE HERE IF YOU**
* You enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on data work, and are motivated by solving complex business problems and turning them into actionable insights
* You’re comfortable challenging assumptions and influencing decision-making, using data to guide discussions and drive better outcomes
* You take ownership and drive initiatives forward, building scalable frameworks and solutions rather than one-off analyses
* You thrive in a cross-functional, fast-moving environment, collaborating closely with different teams to create impact


**What We Offer**
 We are a value-driven company with our values We Team Up, Innovation Drives Us, Inclusion and Non-Hierarchy, and Going the Extra Mile at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

 At Haypp Group you can always expect supportive colleagues who want to achieve things together and a culture where everyone’s voice matters. We encourage ideas from all parts of the organization and are not afraid to try new things. At the same time, we celebrate achievements and recognize the hard work that goes into reaching them.
   

  

 Because our people are our most important differentiator, we offer generous benefits including:
   

  

* Competitive occupational pension
* Insurance plan, including private healthcare
* 30 days of paid vacation
* Parental pay lift
* Wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK per year
* Regular social activities and team events


**SEND US YOUR APPLICATION TODAY**
 If this sounds like a place where you would want to contribute and grow, we would love to hear from you. Haypp Group is committed to equality and diversity and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or marital status. As many of us will be on summer holidays, things may move a bit slower during mid-July. We will continuously review applications, but plan to pick up pace again and start conducting interviews in August.
   

  

 The Haypp Group is spearheading the global transformation from smoking to healthier product alternatives. With origins in Scandinavia our extensive experience from pioneering markets in smoke free alternatives, as well as being a leader in the e-commerce sector, we now fully bring our vision to a global scale.
   

  

 With 11 e-commerce brands, the Haypp Group is present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 100 000 consumers.

description:

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**




 As a Workforce Management Expert, you translate labour standards and labour demand into practical, store‑ready workforce plans. **You will:**



* Own and maintain the global WFM scheduling rulebook, defining how staffing and scheduling should be built
* Ensure scheduling rules are aligned with global standards, local labour regulations and operational needs
* Define standard rosters by store format and segment, including role mix and coverage by daypart
* Translate labour hours into recommended staffing levels by role, skill and time of day
* Create and maintain shift templates aligned with demand peaks, customer flows and operational rhythms across front of house, back of house and omnichannel
* Define and evolve skill logic to reflect operational changes and new store initiatives
* Partner with Sales Markets to integrate local labour laws into the global WFM logic
* Collaborate closely with Labour Standards and Labour Demand Experts to ensure smooth integration into staffing and scheduling logic
* Work with Tech and WFM product teams to translate rules into system configuration and algorithm inputs
* Provide expert guidance and support to markets on scheduling, staffing logic and skills

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH**

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Deep experience within workforce management, scheduling optimisation or WFM systems

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Software, the fuel for mobility**  

  

We bring bold digital visions to life. So we’re on the lookout for more curious and creative engineers who want to create change – one line of high-quality code at a time. Our transformation isn't for everyone, but if you're excited about solving the leading-edge technological challenges facing the auto industry, then let’s talk about your next move.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------

  

Volvo Cars is growing and facing an exciting future in the electrification of vehicles. If you want to utilize state of the art methods to test and verify next generation electrified luxury cars, the role as our new Hardware in the loop (HIL) Development Engineer is the role for you to prosper!  

  

You will be part of an HIL Development team in the eART Software Factory within the Product Stream Electric Propulsion. You will be a member of a truly international team designing HIL test-environments for production software testing. Meaning the HIL models, you will create is crucial for testing electrical propulsion ECUs used in the Traction Battery, Charging and Electric Drive Systems.

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

Volvo Cars’ development centers around software (SW) and in our next generation vehicles, we take a giant leap into the future by launching a capable centralized compute platform, hosting most of the in-house developed SW. In these next generation vehicles, we are building a computer-in-the-car architecture.  

  

The Propulsion & Energy unit is located at Gothenburg. The department, Propulsion & Energy Quality has an Enabling ART (Agile Release Train) within Propulsion & Energy, with the purpose to provide the infrastructure for SW development teams to integrate, test, and release SW in a continuous integration (CI) flow. The infrastructure includes development and maintenance of Hardware-in-Loop setups for development, verification, and validation of software products. We do this by building a robust and automated test framework and enabling SW test & release in a CI flow.  

  

We are looking for our future team member to develop, validate and maintain Model-Based Hardware in Loop setups that are intended for software functionality verification on embedded systems. The embedded test setups are built around the above-mentioned Propulsion & Energy architecture. These setups are a combination of simulated vehicle components and real hardware components to emulate a real vehicle with all the relevant dynamics. Our team are responsible for the development and maintenance of these embedded setups (hardware-in-loop), while making sure that these setups are capable to execute relevant test cases for platform, software, and function verification. These are state-of-the art test setups, critical for testing software before the final product is launched. Hence, you will be working in a fast paced, innovative environment, solving problems and challenges daily.  

  

We offer you to work in a small cross functional team, with high focus on quality and continuous improvements. Together with your colleagues, you will define, set up and configure these test environments supporting our current and future projects. You will be working with Software application and deployment on core computer and embedded ECUs, model all relevant components and signals to enable test automation, moving us towards Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment. Together with us, you will grow your competence and get a broad understanding of Volvo Cars Next Generation Vehicles and Software Platform along with domain growth in Propulsion & Energy. You will work closely with other groups at Volvo Cars, our suppliers and get the opportunity to create a wide network.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

You will fit well in this role if you are a Modeling and Simulation Engineer focusing on model-based development on HIL test beds and an understanding of Software Verification cycles correlated to Model Based Development (SIL, MIL, HIL and VIL)  

  

We believe you are an individual who is motivated by challenging tasks in a complex and innovative environment. Execution of challenging technology development and teamwork is your real passion. You enjoy learning from others, as well as sharing your knowledge with your colleague and are social, structured, analytical, and a problem solver.  

  

We see that you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in SW Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent with emphasis on SW development. You have extensive experience in either dynamic modelling using Matlab/Simulink or test automation. Experience from an Agile working environment and from Continuous Integration is beneficial.  

  

You are fluent in English.

  

* Software/ Plant model development (python, Matlab/Simulink, Stateflow)
* Experience with HIL systems and real-time simulation
* Experience in Continuous Integration
* dSPACE toolchain (ConfigurationDesk, AutomationDesk, ControlDesk,...)
* Knowledge of modeling electric motors, power electronics, and traction battery systems
* Automation of software test
* CAN and Automotive Ethernet communications
  


Meritorious:

  

* Experience from SW platform development, including middleware.
* Knowledge in Electric Propulsion simulation
* Knowledge in integration of sensor technologies
* Verification in vehicles at system or functional level or experience from test automation
* Experience in Core, Domain development/testing.
  

**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.
  

  

At Volvo Cars, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with a passion for making a difference. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to help redefine the future of mobility, we invite you to be part of our journey.  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than 13th of August 2026. You will receive a confirmation email after your submission.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates will undergo a background check.  

  

We welcome your application!

### **Vem är du?**


Du är en erfaren och självgående systemadministratör som gillar att förstå hela miljön – från fysisk server och nätverk till operativsystem, databas och applikation.

Vi samarbetar med kunder och partners över hela Skandinavien inom bland annat telekom, industri, offentlig sektor, retail samt sport och mode. Vår verksamhet bygger på värderingarna pannben, enkelhet, laganda, långsiktighet och stolthet – något som genomsyrar både vårt arbete och vårt sätt att vara mot varandra. title: Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.


**This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.**


### **Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring**


**The Opportunity:**



The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.



Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.



The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.



The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.



As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.


**What you'll be doing:**



As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:


* **Own features end-to-end across the stack**: from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React
* **Design and evolve systems, not just features**: contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales
* **Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows** that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform
* **Make the product operable at enterprise scale**: the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence
* **Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables** and iterate quickly based on feedback
* **Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation**: our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature
* **Be a part of the team's on-call rotation** and take ownership of the services you're running


We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.


**Technologies you'll work with:**


* Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
* TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
* Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
* k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
* Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)


**What Makes You a Great Fit:**


* You are **comfortable working in a remote-first company**; communication is key.
* For us, working together means being **collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful**. We operate by consensus. You can contribute to a discussion, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision. You are able to communicate design decisions clearly in written and spoken English.
* **Strong Go, or a path to it.** We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.
* **Operational mindset.** You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
* You are a **systems thinker**: you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.
* **Pragmatism and short feedback loops.** You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
* You have a good understanding of **a software development process that takes a user-centered approach**. You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
* You use **AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow** - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

title: Strategisk HL Bilaterala frågor (SIR)
description:
*Vill du bidra till Sveriges säkerhet i en digitaliserad värld?*  

Försvarsmakten (FM) spelar en avgörande roll i att utveckla och stärka Sveriges cyberförsvar. Som en del av totalförsvaret arbetar vi varje dag för att skydda våra system mot avancerade hot från främmande aktörer.


Vi söker nu en strategisk handläggare för bilaterala frågor som vill bidra till vår verksamhet på Cyberförsvarsledningen (CFL) och har intresse av utvecklas inom central myndighetsförvaltning och cyberförsvar.  

  

Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett kvalificerat arbete med ett meningsfullt uppdrag – att bidra till att värna vårt öppna samhälle. Vi finns i moderna lokaler på Östermalm i Stockholm. Vi värdesätter ömsesidigt förtroende och hos oss får du ett eget ansvar och goda möjligheter att kompetensutvecklas.


**Om rollen**


Försvarsmakten fortsätter att utveckla cyberförsvaret och söker dig som vill vara en del i att forma Sveriges roll inom EU, Nato och i bilaterala samverkansform. Utvecklingen är en del av det övergripande arbetet med att stärka totalförsvaret och Försvarsmaktens operativa förmåga, enskilt och inom alliansen.


Läs gärna mer om oss och vår verksamhet här: Cyberförsvar


**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**


* Beredning av en variation av frågor på militärstrategisk nivå inom cyberförsvarsområdet och med särskilt fokus på bilaterala samarbeten
* Självständigt driva tilldelade uppgifter enskilt samt tillsammans med andra
* Hantering av både myndighetsinterna och externa remisser
* Tyngdpunkten ligger i samverkan och samarbete med andra delar av Försvarsmakten och externa organisationer samt planering, inriktning och uppföljning av cyberförsvarets verksamhet ur ett nationellt och internationellt perspektiv.

**Vi söker dig som uppfyller något av följande två alternativa krav:**


Antingen har:


* en akademisk examen med statsvetenskaplig, juridisk eller säkerhetspolitisk profil samt


* minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet där du inom offentlig förvaltning eller näringslivet haft arbetsuppgifter relaterat till myndighetsförvaltning och remisshantering på nationell eller internationell nivå



eller har:


* en akademisk examen inom datateknik eller annan inriktning inom det datortekniska eller datavetenskapliga området samt


* minst tre års arbetslivserfarenhet inom it-området.



För båda alternativen ovan ställs också krav på god förmåga att kunna analysera, sammanställa och presentera material både muntligt och skriftligt på såväl svenska som engelska.


**Det är meriterande om du har:**


* erfarenhet av samverkan och remisshantering på nationell eller internationell nivå
* utbildning och erfarenhet som projektledare
* erfarenhet av att leda eller inrikta informations- och cybersäkerhetsrelaterad verksamhet
* aktuell och relevant tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet inom Försvarsmakten eller annan myndighet eller organisation inom totalförsvars- och säkerhetsfrågor
* aktuell och relevant tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet av FM:s eller NATO:s militära planeringsprocesser gärna på militärstrategisk eller operativ nivå


**Vem är du?**


För oss är det viktigt att du har hög inlärningskapacitet och självständigt kan leverera underlag med god kvalitet inom angivna tidsförhållanden. Du trivs med ett högt tempo samt har en god samarbetsförmåga.


Vi ser att du är en trygg och stabil person med hög integritet och förmåga att ta initiativ och hitta lösningar.


**Övrigt**


* Anställningsform: Tillsvidare (6 månaders provanställning)
* Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid
* Arbetsort: Stockholm
* Resor förekommer, både inom och utanför Sverige
* Tillträde enligt överenskommelse


Frågor om tjänsten och Fackliga representanter nås via: cyberintresse@mil.se


**Övriga krav:**  

Du bör inte berätta att du har sökt tjänst hos Cyberförsvarsledningen för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Anledningen till att vi ber dig vara återhållsam med information är att vissa tjänster vid förbandet omfattas av sekretess. För anställning vid Försvarsmakten krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Med anställning följer nationell och internationell arbetsskyldighet. Urvalsprocessen kommer att kompletteras med arbetspsykologiska tester.


**Ansökan**


Välkommen med din ansökan senast **2026-08-31**, urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.


Din ansökan ska innehålla CV och ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattningen samt svarar på dessa två urvalsfrågor.:


* Beskriv en situation där du behövde sätta dig in i ett nytt eller komplext område. Hur gick du tillväga för att tillägna dig den kunskap som krävdes och hur säkerställde du att du självständigt kunde leverera ett underlag av god kvalitet?


* Ge ett exempel på en situation där du ställdes inför ett problem eller en oväntad utmaning som riskerade att påverka kvalitet eller tidsplan. Beskriv hur du analyserade situationen, vilka åtgärder du vidtog för att hitta en lösning och hur du säkerställde att leveransen höll god kvalitet trots förutsättningarna.


Mejla din ansökan enligt ovan till: cyberintresse@mil.se  

OBS! Kom ihåg att ange referens i din ansökan: [8394]

title: Systemadministratör till socialförvaltningen
description:
Inom socialförvaltningen är du med och gör skillnad, både för enskilda människor och för kommunen i stort. När du arbetar här kan du vara säker på att få engagera dig i meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter. Vi utreder och beslutar om stöd till barn och ungdomar, familjer, äldre, personer med funktionsnedsättning samt människor i behov av stöd i olika livssituationer. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att ge den högsta kvaliteten på den service vi erbjuder.


Trivs du med att hjälpa människor, lösa problem och ge riktigt bra service? Har du ett intresse för digitala verktyg och vill arbeta nära verksamheten? Då kan du vara den vi söker.



Vi söker nu en systemadministratör som blir en viktig stödfunktion för socialförvaltningens medarbetare. Rollen passar dig som får energi av att hjälpa andra, tycker om att ge service och vill bidra till att våra digitala lösningar fungerar smidigt i vardagen.


**Ditt nya jobb**

  


Som systemadministratör är du förstalinjens support och en viktig kontaktperson för våra medarbetare. Du hjälper kollegor med frågor kring våra verksamhetssystem, guidar dem i deras dagliga arbete och ser till att de har rätt förutsättningar för att använda våra digitala verktyg.



Det handlar lika mycket om människor som om system. Du möter användare med ett positivt bemötande, löser problem på ett pedagogiskt sätt och ser till att de känner sig trygga och får den hjälp de behöver.



Du arbetar bland annat med verksamhetssystem som Lifecare, Stratsys, Appva och Visma. Rollen omfattar även registervård, behörighetsadministration samt hantering och beställning av teknisk utrustning som datorer, telefoner och personlarm.



Du blir en del av teamet Digital utveckling inom Förvaltningsstöd. Teamet består idag av två systemförvaltare och en programledare med ansvar för digitalisering och AI. Tillsammans arbetar vi nära verksamheten för att utveckla och förbättra våra digitala arbetssätt.



Det här gör du hos oss:


* ger support och vägledning till användare i våra verksamhetssystem
* hjälper kollegor att komma igång med datorer, telefoner och annan arbetsplatsutrustning
* administrerar behörigheter och arbetar med registervård
* är superanvändare i flera verksamhetssystem
* hanterar och beställer teknisk utrustning
* fångar upp verksamhetens behov och bidrar med förbättringsförslag
* samarbetar nära både verksamheten och övriga funktioner inom digital utveckling


**Din profil**



Vi söker dig som tycker om att ge service och som ser värdet i att hjälpa andra att lyckas i sitt arbete. Du har ett gott bemötande, är lyhörd och trivs med många kontaktytor. När någon behöver hjälp är du den som gärna ställer upp och hittar en lösning.



Du har ett intresse för digitala verktyg och lär dig snabbt nya system. Du arbetar strukturerat, tar ansvar och har förmåga att förklara på ett enkelt och pedagogiskt sätt.



Eftersom du har daglig kontakt med många medarbetare har du också lätt för att kommunicera och skapa förtroende.



Vi tror att du:


* har god systemvana och ett intresse för digitala lösningar
* har ett genuint intresse för service och att hjälpa andra
* kommunicerar tydligt och pedagogiskt på svenska i tal och skrift
* arbetar strukturerat och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter
* har lätt för att samarbeta och skapa goda relationer
* är lösningsorienterad och trivs i en varierad vardag


Erfarenhet av verksamhetssystem inom socialförvaltning, exempelvis Lifecare, Stratsys, Appva eller Visma, är meriterande. Även erfarenhet av support eller systemadministration är en fördel.



Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. För oss är det viktigt att du är en person som tycker om att ge service, har ett professionellt bemötande och vill vara ett uppskattat stöd för dina kollegor.



Hos oss får du en varierad och utvecklande roll med många kontaktytor och möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i vardagen. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team som arbetar nära verksamheten och tillsammans driver socialförvaltningens digitala utveckling framåt.


**Anställningens omfattning**



100%


**Anställningsvillkor**



För denna roll ligger ingångslönen normalt mellan 30 000 - 38 000 kr beroende på erfarenhet och kompetens. I vissa fall kan mer seniora kandidater erbjudas högre lön inom rollens totala spann.



Via denna länk får du information om vårt kollektivavtal (HÖK:arna)



Det är vårt kollektivavtal som reglerar villkoren för anställningen såsom lön, arbetstid, ersättningar och övriga förmåner inom sektorn.


**Anställningsform**



Tillsvidare


**Tillträde**



Enligt överenskommelse

17 augusti 2026



Visst låter det spännande? Registrera din ansökan via knappen ”Ansök”. Vi kan tyvärr inte ta emot ansökningar på något annat sätt.



Gå gärna in och läs mer på osteraker.se/jobbaiösteråker



Österåkers kommun söker dig som har kompetens att bidra till våra verksamheter oavsett kön, könsidentitet eller könsuttryck, ålder, etnisk tillhörighet, religion eller annan trosuppfattning, sexuell läggning eller funktionsnedsättning. Precis som vi har du också ett barnrättsperspektiv i ditt dagliga arbete, i enlighet med barnkonventionen.



Kontaktuppgifter till våra fackliga företrädare hittar ni på vår webbplats.



Vi har inför denna rekrytering tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda. Vi önskar därför att inte bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.


Tre mil till Stockholm, 1 100 öar, 93 mil kustlinje och ett lite härligare sätt att leva. title: Head of IT Operations & End User Experience
description:
Munters is looking for a Head of IT Operations & End User Experience to lead the global operational performance of our workplace and site IT services and shape the technology experience for employees across offices, engineering centers and manufacturing sites. The team consists of around 40 employees across APAC, Europe and the Americas, currently working in a regional structure.


In this role, you will build a globally aligned service organization that combines consistent global capabilities with strong local presence and business understanding. A key part of the mandate is to modernize traditional support and operations through AI, automation, intelligent self-service, modern IT service management and Microsoft workplace technologies. The ambition is to leverage existing structures and modern technology to enable a global L1 service capability while maintaining strong local support where it matters most.


The role balances two equally important responsibilities: ensuring stable, secure and efficient day-to-day service delivery, while continuously improving how IT end user services are delivered, consumed and experienced across Munters. You will work closely with the full IT leadership team, especially Security & Infrastructure and Application Engineering, to create one integrated technology organization with clear accountability, strong governance and a seamless end-to-end service experience.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead global IT operations and service delivery across EMEA, Americas and APAC, ensuring stable, secure and reliable support for employees and business-critical sites.
* Own workplace technologies, service desk, device deployment and lifecycle services, local site IT operations, escalation models and major incident management.
* Establish a globally aligned service delivery model with clear ownership, accountability and governance across L1/L2/L3, in close collaboration with Infrastructure & Security and Application Engineering.
* Design and mature a scalable Level 1 capability combining self-service, AI-assisted support, remote delivery and effective local escalation.
* Drive standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement across services, processes and tools, using data, analytics and employee feedback.
* Own the strategy, roadmap, service design and operational performance of Microsoft 365 and common workplace services, including governance, lifecycle management and cost-effective licensing.
* Partner with business functions, HR and Communications to increase adoption of collaboration, communication, productivity and AI capabilities.
* Lead and develop a global team with a strong service mindset, business understanding and clear accountability for outcomes.
* Manage strategic vendors, service providers and key workplace technology partners to deliver consistent quality, performance and value.
* Own budgets, service costs, commercial performance and productivity improvements within the area.
**What we are looking for**

* Proven experience leading global IT Operations, Workplace Services, Site IT, Service Delivery or End User Experience organizations.
* Ability to lead global teams, vendors and transformation across regions while balancing operational discipline, security, standardization and local business needs.
* Experience from complex operational environments spanning offices, engineering centers and manufacturing or other business-critical sites.
* Strong understanding of modern IT service management, operational excellence, service ownership, governance and continuous improvement.
* Experience establishing or maturing global service desk and Level 1 capabilities, including multi-provider service models.
* Demonstrated experience using AI, automation, self-service and data-driven approaches to transform support and service delivery.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Copilot, modern workplace platforms, endpoint services and licensing models.
* Strong commercial, stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to connect technology decisions to business value and employee experience.

Polismyndighetens IT-avdelning har drygt 1300 anställda och tillsammans sköter vi drift, underhåll och utveckling av IT-stödet till myndighetens olika verksamhetsområden för ca 40 000 anställda. IT-miljön är unik, stor, komplex och fylld av utmaningar som få andra organisationer kan matcha.


Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens kärnuppdrag genom att säkerställa att rätt person har tillgång till rätt information, vid rätt tidpunkt. Vi erbjuder:

**Arbetsbeskrivning**
---------------------


I rollen som Teknisk Testare kommer du ha en central roll hos oss där du bidrar till vår utveckling genom att vara drivande i testerna, planera och utveckla teststrategin för att leverera applikationer med hög kvalitet. Som Teknisk testare hos oss leder och driver du arbetet med testautomation. Arbetet kompletteras med utforskande och manuell testning. Vid behov coachar du även teamet i testfrågor. Arbetet bedrivs tillsammans med flera andra roller. Testverktyg som används är bl.a. Selenium, Cypress och SoapUI.


Du kommer att ingå i ett agilt, självorganiserande team där du får stora möjligheter att påverka din vardag och våra tekniska val. Vi arbetar med ständiga förbättringar och levererar rätt sak i rätt tid genom kontinuerliga, mindre leveranser.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innebär att:
