title: Senior Cyber Security Consultant
description:
Join Polar Point and help shape cybersecurity that makes a real difference
   

  

 At Polar Point, you will not be one consultant among many. You will join a growing cybersecurity company where senior expertise, trust and customer impact are at the center of everything we do.
   

  

 We work closely with CISOs, IT leaders and security teams to help organizations strengthen resilience, reduce risk and gain better control of their digital environments. Our work combines strategic advisory, hands-on implementation and long-term customer relationships.
   

  

 As a Senior Cyber Security Consultant, you will have the opportunity to influence both our customers’ security journeys and Polar Point’s continued growth. You will work in meaningful assignments, contribute to our service offerings and help build a company where technical excellence, clarity and responsibility matter.
   

  

**About Polar Point**
 Polar Point AB is a Stockholm-based cybersecurity consultancy helping Nordic organizations navigate complexity with clarity. We provide senior expertise, advisory services and practical security solutions that enable customers to manage cyber risk confidently while staying focused on their business.
   

  

 Our core areas include identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, security platform implementation, compliance support, security health checks, AI security and project-based cybersecurity delivery.
   

  

 We are independent, pragmatic and outcome-focused. Our ambition is to be a trusted cybersecurity partner for organizations that need senior guidance, hands-on expertise and clear progress in complex environments.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Cyber Security Consultant at Polar Point, you will play a key role in delivering high-value cybersecurity services to our customers while contributing to the growth and development of our consulting practice.
   

  

 You will combine deep technical understanding with advisory capability and business awareness. In practice, this means that you can move comfortably between strategic discussions with customer leadership, solution design with technical teams and hands-on delivery in complex customer environments.
   

  

 You will act as a trusted advisor, lead important security initiatives and help customers prioritise improvements that reduce risk and strengthen operational maturity. You will also contribute to business development in a consultative way by identifying customer needs, shaping new engagements and helping develop services that create measurable value.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Customer delivery and technical leadership
   

  

* Lead and deliver cybersecurity consulting engagements in complex customer environments.
* Design, implement and improve security solutions across endpoint security, vulnerability management, identity, cloud and hybrid environments.
* Perform security assessments and translate findings into pragmatic, risk-based recommendations.
* Provide senior technical guidance during implementations, security transformations and improvement programmes.
* Help customers strengthen cybersecurity hygiene, visibility, control and operational resilience.
* Support customers in aligning security improvements with business priorities, regulatory expectations and practical implementation constraints.


 Advisory and project leadership
   

  

* Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs, IT leaders and other senior stakeholders.
* Lead security projects and initiatives from planning and scoping through execution and follow-up.
* Coordinate stakeholders, manage scope, timelines, risks and dependencies.
* Support customer decision-making by explaining complex security topics in a clear and business-relevant way.
* Contribute to structured methods, playbooks, assessments and best practices used across Polar Point engagements.


 Business development and practice growth
   

  

* Identify customer needs and opportunities within existing and new engagements.
* Support pre-sales activities such as customer meetings, solution design, scoping and effort estimation.
* Contribute to proposals, presentations and service development.
* Help shape and improve Polar Point’s cybersecurity offerings.
* Share knowledge internally and support colleagues as we grow the consulting team.
* Contribute to long-term customer relationships by delivering quality, clarity and trust in every assignment.


 Who you are
   

  

 You are an experienced cybersecurity professional who enjoys combining technical depth with advisory work. You are confident in customer-facing situations and comfortable working with both technical specialists and senior decision-makers.
   

  

 You probably enjoy solving complex problems, creating structure in uncertain situations and helping customers move from analysis to practical improvement. You take ownership, communicate clearly and care about delivering outcomes that matter.
   

  

**You Will Likely Thrive At Polar Point If You**
* want to be part of a growing specialist consultancy rather than a large anonymous organisation
* enjoy having influence over both customer delivery and company development
* are comfortable taking senior responsibility in customer engagements
* value trust, transparency and long-term relationships
* like working close to experienced colleagues, founders and decision-makers
* want to combine strategic advisory with hands-on cybersecurity delivery


 We believe you have
   

  

* Approximately 10 years or more of experience in cybersecurity, security consulting or senior security delivery roles.
* Strong experience delivering cybersecurity improvements in customer or enterprise environments.
* Solid knowledge in one or more of the following areas: endpoint security, vulnerability management, identity and access management, cloud security, Microsoft security services, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID or security platform implementation.
* Experience leading or contributing to security projects, implementations or improvement programmes.
* Ability to translate technical findings into business-relevant recommendations.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders such as CISOs, CIOs, IT leaders or security managers.
* A consultative mindset and the ability to identify customer needs, shape solutions and contribute to business development.
* Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.
* Fluency in Swedish, written and spoken.
* Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance when required.


 It is a plus if you also have
   

  

* Experience from large, complex or regulated organizations.
* Experience with security assessments, security health checks, Zero Trust initiatives or cyber maturity improvement.
* Experience with technologies and platforms such as Microsoft 365 Security, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Tanium, Trend Vision One, BeyondTrust, Rapid7 or similar tools.
* Experience in IAM, PAM, endpoint management, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, compliance or security operations.
* Experience working with frameworks or regulations such as ISO 27001, NIS2, NIST CSF, DORA or similar.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Microsoft security certifications or vendor-specific certifications.


 Certifications are valuable, but practical experience, sound judgement and proven customer impact matter most to us.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 At Polar Point, you will join a senior and entrepreneurial team with high ambitions and low prestige. We offer an environment where you can make a visible impact from day one - both for our customers and for the company we are building.
   

  

**We Offer**
* senior and meaningful cybersecurity assignments with real customer impact
* close collaboration with experienced consultants, founders and company leadership
* the opportunity to shape our services, methods and ways of working
* a trust-based culture with high responsibility and flexibility
* strong focus on quality, clarity and long-term customer relationships
* room to grow professionally as Polar Point grows
* access to a wider specialist network through our partner ecosystem and alliance relationships
* the chance to help build a cybersecurity consultancy with a clear Nordic identity and strong ambitions


 Location and working model
   

  

 The role is based in Stockholm, with flexibility depending on assignment and customer needs. Some work will be performed remotely, while customer presence is expected when it creates value or is required for delivery.
   

  

 Because many of our customers operate in Swedish-speaking environments, fluent Swedish is required.
   

  

 Apply
   

  

 If you want to help build a trusted cybersecurity consultancy with senior colleagues, meaningful assignments and real influence, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

 At Polar Point, you will help customers strengthen security where it matters most - from users and identities to devices, platforms and business-critical environments.
   

  

 We help organisations navigate complexity with clarity. Our cybersecurity solutions are built on trust, transparency and technical excellence. Let us manage the risks, so you can focus on growth.

title: Senior Mainframe Operations Specialists
description:
CGI is looking for several experienced Mainframe Operations Specialists to join a client assignment within the Financial Services sector in Stockholm.
   

  

 As a specialist within one or more of the following areas: MQ, IMS, DB2, z/OS, or RACF, you will become part of a highly experienced team of consultants operating a secure, business-critical mainframe environment.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to work in a complex and mission-critical infrastructure where stability, availability, security, and continuous improvement are key priorities. You will collaborate closely with both technical experts and business stakeholders while contributing to the evolution of a modern mainframe platform.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

 As a Senior Mainframe Specialist, you will play a key role in:
   

  

* System programming and maintenance of z/OS and related subsystems
* Working closely with domain owners for MQ on z/OS, IMS, and/or DB2, depending on your area of expertise
* Software installation, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance activities
* Incident investigation, problem management, and operational support
* Managing certificates, encryption technologies, and security-related configurations
* Participating in on-call duty and planned infrastructure activities
* Driving modernization initiatives, automation, and continuous improvements
* Ensuring that the mainframe operating system and its core subsystems provide a secure, resilient, and cost-efficient foundation for mission-critical applications


**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
 To succeed in this role, you bring:
   

  

* At least 10 years of hands-on experience working within mainframe environments
* Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas:


 z/OS
   

  

 MQ
   

  

 IMS
   

  

 DB2
   

  

 RACF
   

  

* Strong experience in system programming, operations, and infrastructure management
* A structured, proactive, and quality-focused approach to your work
* A genuine interest in automation, performance optimization, capacity planning, and troubleshooting
* A collaborative mindset where knowledge sharing and teamwork are highly valued
* The ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


 Why CGI?
   

  

 We combine global expertise with local delivery and offer an environment where innovation, collaboration, and ownership are at the heart of everything we do.

title: Specialist inom Lumera eller på väg att bli det
description:
* Ansök senast: 16 augusti 2026
* Hybrid


 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

*Lockas du av att arbeta med IT-drift, förstå system på djupet och lösa problem som verkligen gör skillnad, där teknik och verksamhet möts varje dag? Vill du dessutom jobba på ett kontor precis vid Centralen? Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar för Lumera framåt, oavsett om du redan kan systemet eller vill lära dig det hos oss.*
 Lumera är ett av våra viktigaste system och en central del av hur vi skapar trygghet för våra kunder. Här möts teknik och verksamhet varje dag, och det arbete vi gör kring systemet märks på riktigt.
   

  

 Hos oss blir du snabbt en del av ett engagerat team där vi ställer upp för varandra och jobbar tätt tillsammans. Vi har olika specialistområden, men delar samma ansvar för att få helheten att fungera. Det är naturligt att be om hjälp, dela kunskap och lösa saker tillsammans, och det är också så vi utvecklas.
   

  

 AMF är ett mindre bolag, vilket gör att du inte försvinner i mängden. Din kompetens syns och uppskattas, och du får möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar. Vi tror på att bygga vår egen kompetens över tid och satsar på att utveckla våra medarbetare till specialister, samtidigt som vi samarbetar nära med både konsulter och leverantör.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 I rollen arbetar du operativt med Lumera och ansvarar tillsammans med teamet för att driften fungerar som den ska i vardagen. Arbetet är varierat och kombinerar löpande drift med analys och förbättringsarbete över tid.
   

  

 Du arbetar i både test- och produktionsmiljö och rör dig mellan olika typer av uppgifter beroende på vad som händer i systemet. Det kan handla om att planera och följa upp körningar, säkerställa att flöden går enligt plan, felsöka incidenter, genomföra installationer eller arbeta med databasen. En del av arbetet innebär också att analysera avvikelser, optimera prestanda och ta fram underlag som bidrar till vidare utveckling.
   

  

 Arbetet inkluderar även viss schemalagd kvälls- och helginsats, vilket planeras gemensamt i teamet.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Hos Oss Får Du En Bred Och Varierad Roll Hos En Arbetsgivare Formad Av Prestigelöshet Och Vänlighet. Det Innebär Till Exempel
   

  

* Ett meningsfullt uppdrag – hos oss bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för 4.5 miljoner människor, i ett bolag där samhällsnytta och långsiktighet står i centrum.
* En kultur där din kompetens tas tillvara – vi värdesätter din expertis och ger dig möjlighet att påverka, utveckla och dela med dig av din kunskap.
* Ett hållbart arbetsliv – hos oss får du balans, flexibilitet och goda förmåner som gör att du kan må bra både på och utanför jobbet.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**Lite mer om dig**
 Vi söker dig som antingen redan kan Lumera och vill fortsätta utvecklas som specialist, eller dig som arbetar med drift idag och är nyfiken på att ta nästa steg genom att lära dig Lumera hos oss. Du kanske är systemförvaltare eller applikationsspecialist och vill bredda din kompetens i en mer tekniskt fördjupad roll. Du har en stabil teknisk grund och känner dig bekväm i miljöer där databaser är en naturlig del av vardagen, exempelvis SQL Server, där du hanterar grundläggande uppgifter som backup, restore och enklare felsökning.
   

  

 Vidare trivs du nära tekniken och motiveras av att få saker att fungera i praktiken. Du tar ansvar, driver arbetet framåt och har ett naturligt driv i att både lösa problem här och nu och förbättra för framtiden. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som bidrar till helheten, delar med dig av din kunskap och bygger goda samarbeten. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska.
   

  

 Vi tror på långsiktighet, men också på utveckling. I en vardag där AI och nya tekniker blir en allt större del av vårt arbete behöver vi vara både stabila och nyfikna. Hos oss innebär det att du är öppen för att arbetsuppgifter kan förändras över tid, att du vågar testa nytt och att du ser lärande som en naturlig del av jobbet. Vi värdesätter ett positivt förhållningssätt, flexibilitet och viljan att tillsammans utforska nya sätt att arbeta.
   

  

**Din ansökan**
 Vi arbetar kompetensbaserat och använder oss av arbetspsykologiska tester som en del i urvalsprocessen. Allt för att säkerställa en fördomsfri och rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill att du bifogar ditt CV och gärna att du svarar på några frågor vi ställer i samband med att du söker. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Platform Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

**The Role**
 We’re looking for a
 **Platform Specialist** 
 to join our team in Stockholm and become a cornerstone of our customer support function. This is an opportunity to deliver outstanding customer service, solve complex issues, and help shape the future of support at Legora.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal Engineering, and Go to Market teams to deliver the best possible experience for our customers. Working closely with lawyers at top tier firms globally, you’ll become an expert in how they use Legora to transform their work. Every day, you’ll solve problems, identify patterns, and make our users’ experience with support feel fast, structured, and deeply helpful.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Deliver exceptional support: Take end-to-end ownership of customer issues for our enterprise clients, delivering fast, precise, and high-quality resolutions in high-stakes, time-sensitive environments.
* Communicate with expertise: Communicate clearly and confidently with demanding professional users, translating technical concepts into concise, actionable guidance.
* Master the product: Develop deep expertise in Legora’s platform to diagnose and resolve complex, high-impact issues that require structured thinking and sound judgment. Guide users through complex workflows, and unlock value for legal teams.
* Drive improvements: Identify recurring issues and user pain points, collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to drive solutions.
* Deliver with excellence: Deliver a consistently high-quality, detail-oriented support experience that reflects the standards of our customers.
* Create resources: Help build and maintain help documentation, FAQs, and best practices that empower users to succeed independently.
* Shape the function: As an early team member, contribute to building processes, workflows, and standards that will scale globally.
* Monitor proactively: Proactively monitor customer usage patterns and identify potential issues before they escalate, ensuring a consistently smooth experience.


**Who You Are**
* You’ve handled complex, high-stakes B2B relationships, taking full ownership of issues and consistently delivering exceptional outcomes.
* You have a proven track record of delighting demanding professional clients and turning frustrated users into advocates.
* You notice patterns, identify potential issues before they escalate, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive lasting improvements.
* You are customer-obsessed and genuinely care about user success.
* You are technically curious and comfortable learning new software quickly, explaining technical concepts clearly.
* You are experienced with support tools like Intercom, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
* Having a background in SaaS, AI, or legal tech environments is a strong plus.


**Why This Role Matters**
 This isn’t just another support role. You’ll be instrumental in:
   

  

* Building the support foundation for one of Europe’s most ambitious AI companies.
* Directly impacting product adoption and customer satisfaction at a critical growth stage.
* Learning from industry experts while helping shape the future of legal AI.
* Growing your career rapidly in a high-growth environment.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Javautvecklare
description:
**Företagsbeskrivning**
 AFRY erbjuder tjänster inom teknik, design, digitalisering och rådgivning. Vi är dedikerade experter inom industri, energi och infrastruktur och skapar värde för kommande generationer. AFRY har nordiska rötter med global räckvidd. Våra gemensamma principer – Result driven, Client centric, Empowering och Accountable – vägleder oss i hur vi arbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Var med och accelerera övergången till ett hållbart samhälle.

 Vi söker en erfaren Javautvecklare till ett långsiktigt uppdrag hos en aktör med ansvar för samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Du kommer att arbeta i en komplex och tekniskt avancerad miljö där systemen ställer höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda.
   

  

 Som konsult på AFRY blir du en del av ett agilt utvecklingsteam där du bidrar till utveckling och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska system.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du designa och utveckla robusta och skalbara applikationer i Java samt bygga och vidareutveckla mikrotjänstarkitekturer och distribuerade system. Utöver detta innefattar rollen även att:
   

  

* Utveckla API:er och arbeta med systemintegrationer mellan olika plattformar
* Delta i moderniseringsresor, exempelvis migrering från legacy-system
* Arbeta med testbarhet, kvalitet och prestanda i system med höga krav
* Bidra till och utveckla CI/CD-flöden och DevOps-arbetssätt
* Delta aktivt i kodgranskningar och kontinuerliga förbättringar
* Samarbeta nära team, arkitekter och verksamhet för att säkerställa rätt lösningar


**Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har en kandidatexamen inom datavetenskap eller liknande område samt minst fem års erfarenhet av Javautveckling i
 **offentlig sektor och/eller i energisektorn.**
 Vi ser gärna att du även har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Spring Boot eller liknande ramverk
* mikrotjänster och distribuerade system
* att utveckla REST API:er och arbeta med integrationer
* versionshantering (t.ex. Git)
* av CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* av containerplattformar som Docker, Kubernetes eller OpenShift är meriterande
* av molnteknologier (Azure, AWS eller liknande) är meriterande


 Du har också en fallenhet för att översätta affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar samt god kommunikativ förmåga och samarbetsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och din vilja att skapa värde för kunder och kollegor.
   

  

**Ytterligare information**
 Vår enhet Digital Services verkar över hela utvecklingskedjan med experter inom projektledning, kravanalys, QA och test, systemutveckling, arkitektur, dataanalys och AI, cybersäkerhet med mera.
   

  

 Vad erbjuder AFRY dig som anställd?
   

  

 Vi har regelbundna träffar där temat varierar mellan kompetens och socialt utbyte, eller både och. En bra balans helt enkelt! Hos oss får du också:
   

  

* En AFRY Buddy som bollplank under din första tid som anställd
* Balans i arbetslivet med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
* Tillgång till Club AFRY där en bredd av spännande och underhållande aktiviteter för våra medarbetare anordnas - det finns något för alla! Läs gärna mer här.
* Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner gällande pension, friskvård och föräldraledighet reglerade i vårt kollektivavtal
* Företagsrabatter med externa partners genom vår förmånsportal Advantage You.
* Friskvårdsbidrag 4500 SEK/år.
* Restauranger och kaféer på plats
* Ett enormt nätverk av tekniska experter med +19 000 kollegor runtom i världen.


**Välkommen med din ansökan, sista ansökningsdag är 2026-08-16**
*Vänligen notera att återkoppling på ansökningar kan dröja något med anledning av semestertider och beräknas ske först i augusti.*
**Kontaktperson för frågor:**
 Aamir Faried, Gruppchef
   

  

 aamir.faried@afry.com
   

  

 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

*På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen*

title: Powertrain Test Engineer
description:
Working at CorPower Ocean you will be part of a world class team, determined to make big impact. We are on a mission to bring reliable and competitive wave energy to the world. We offer a high degree of autonomy, combined with great personal responsibility. CorPower Ocean is a global leader in wave energy, with a technology that has shown game-changing performance. Join us in transforming ocean energy into a reliable, renewable power source—and help shape the future of sustainable technology.
  
Role Description
  
You will support the design, assembly and operation of our Powertrain test rig to test and validate the components of our future powertrains (generator, inverter, gearbox, battery, etc.). As a member of the Assembly and Test (A&T) team, your work includes collaborating with our Powertrain engineering team to develop test rigs and test plans, conduct tests, analyse data, and troubleshoot hardware and software issues. This position requires hands-on with our equipment hardware and structured verification process to ensure the EES integrates safely and reliably, maintains grid stability, and fulfills obligations under the relevant Grid Code.
  
Responsibilities (and Duties)
  
* A&T team member responsible for the Powertrain test rig, contributing to the design and leading the assembly, test and operation of the Powertrain test rig.
* Carry out the verification of the specifications of the functional + software requirements, covering all the test rig functions
* Carry out the grid connected EES verification (net consumer)
* Carry out the grid compliance verification (generation connection)
* Develop test automation and maintain monitoring of test rig
* Maintain functional testing resources under operational conditions.
* Clearly communicate issues, successes, and challenges through regular activity reports.
* Use your electronic & mechanical skills and experience to design and participate in test benches
* Support test data analysis and reduction to assess performance and function, identify anomalies, and assisting with data needed to validate analytical or finite element models
* Prepare test plans, reports, and technical documentation, clearly summarizing methods, results, and conclusions.
* Collaborate with design, analysis, and manufacturing teams to resolve structural issues and support design improvement


Qualifications and skills
  
* A power electronic background with proved experience on inverters, generators, battery management systems (software experience a plus)
* Languages: Proficient in English verbally and in writing
* More than 5 years proven as a test engineer for test rigs with inverters, generators and battery management
* More than 3 years proven experience of EES and grid compliance verification
* Ability to analyze complex data and identify root causes of problems.
* Strong Communication skills, both orally and in writing, and enjoy working in a business-related role with several contact points
* You can work independently, be proactive and thrive in a fast-growing company.


**As a person:**  

* You are striving for excellence, put quality into everything you do
* You are self-motivated and constantly seek the most efficient ways to work
* You always search for simple and elegant solutions to difficult problems
* You love to learn new things, and take pride in constantly developing your skills
* You are persistent, knowing it takes stamina to reach pioneering goals
* You see your tasks through to completion
* You are comfortable in presenting your solutions internally and externally
* You are data driven and strive to always back your points with solid analysis

title: System Engineer
description:
L&T Technology Services Limited (LTTS) is a global leader in Engineering and R&D (ER&D) services.
  
We are hiring in Gothenburg, Sweden!
  
Would you like to join a team with innovation, teamwork and entrepreneurship as the fundamental platform?
  
We are looking for experienced System Engineers for the Automotive Industry.
  
System Designer – Job Description
  
As a System Designer, you will be responsible for defining and developing system architectures for vehicle stability and motion control functions such as ESC, Traction Control, and Yaw Control. You will translate performance, safety, and diagnostic requirements into robust system designs while collaborating closely with software, hardware, calibration, and feature teams to ensure end-to-end functionality. The role includes system documentation, concept evaluation through modeling and simulation, support for functional safety activities in compliance with ISO 26262, and participation in integration, verification, and validation activities, including SIL/HIL testing and vehicle-level assessments.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Develop system architectures and functional designs for vehicle motion control features.
  
Define and manage system requirements, diagnostics, and safety-related specifications.
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver complete system solutions.
  
Create and maintain system design documentation and interface definitions.
  
Support simulations, concept studies, and performance evaluations.
  
Contribute to functional safety activities, including HARA, safety concepts, and DFMEA.
  
  

Support system integration, verification, and validation through SIL/HIL and vehicle testing
  
  

Soft Skills
  
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  
Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate in cross-functional environments.
  
  

Education
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, Automotive, or related field.

title: Functional Safety Engineer
description:
**Job ID** 2026-18472 **Date posted** Jul. 27, 2026 **Location** Lund, Sweden **Category** Software Engineering
  
**Job Description:**
--------------------


We are looking for a skilled and motivated Functional Safety Engineer to join Arm's GPU Safety team.


In this role, you will help deliver functional safety solutions for next-generation GPU products targeting automotive, robotics, and other safety-critical applications. Working closely with architecture, hardware development, verification and software teams, you will play a role in the development of safety concepts, safety analyses, and safety work products throughout the product lifecycle.


This is an excellent opportunity for engineers with a strong hardware background who are passionate about developing safe, high-quality products and advancing the state of the art in functional safety.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


As a Functional Safety Engineer, you will:


* Develop and review functional safety work products in accordance with ISO 26262.
* Create and maintain Safety Plans, Safety Cases, Safety Manuals and related documentation.
* Perform safety analyses including FMEA, DFA, FTA and FMEDA.
* Support hardware and software teams in deriving and implementing safety requirements.
* Write, review and manage safety requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in Functional Safety audits, assessments and reviews.
* Support tool qualification activities where required.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Arm's Functional Safety methodologies and processes.
* Collaborate across multiple engineering teams to ensure safety objectives are successfully achieved.

**Required Skills and Experience :**
------------------------------------


* Good understanding of computer architecture and modern SoC design principles.
* Knowledge of functional safety concepts and standards, particularly ISO 26262.
* Experience in RTL design of complex ASICs, IPs or SoCs.
* Experience with safety analysis techniques such as Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Dependent Failure Analysis(DFA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), or FMEDA.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-functional environment.

**“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience :**
------------------------------------------


* Experience with GPU, CPU or other complex processor architectures.
* Familiarity with verification methodologies including System Verilog, UVM or formal verification.
* Experience with industry-standard EDA tools (e.g. Cadence or Synopsys).
* Knowledge of requirements management tools such as Jama, DRM or similar.
* Exposure to both hardware and software functional safety development.
* Experience supporting external or internal safety assessments and audits.

**Why Join Us?:**
-----------------


You will work with some of the industry's leading experts in GPU and functional safety technologies, helping shape the future of safety-capable computing platforms used in automotive and other critical markets. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative products while developing deep expertise in one of the fastest-growing areas of semiconductor engineering.
